* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump (SKY130, transistor-level)
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Architecture:
*   - Active-high EN: 5V-device inverter + PMOS power-gate header (AVDD -> vddi)
*     keeps disabled AVDD current at leakage level.
*   - Cross-coupled voltage doubler (two 20pF MIM flying caps, complementary
*     rail-to-rail drivers from the gated 10MHz clock) charges internal rail
*     vpp (~2*VDD) with an 80pF MIM reservoir.
*   - Series PMOS regulator from vpp to VOUT. Error amp (5T OTA supplied from
*     vpp, tail current mirrored from the 1uA IBN1U bias) compares
*     VOUT*(5/13) with AVDD*(1/2) using matched xhigh_po dividers, so
*     VOUT = 1.3*AVDD ratiometrically across PVT.
*   - Dominant pole at the external 1nF load; small pass device keeps the
*     gate-node pole well above the loop unity-gain frequency.

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

XCDI vddi AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_2 w=141 l=141

XGP2 ckn EN  vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XGN1 ckn CLK ng1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XGN2 ng1 EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XI0P ck0 ckn vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XI0N ck0 ckn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* phase d2 (inverse of ck0), 3 stages
XA1P da1 ck0 vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XA1N da1 ck0 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XA2P da2 da1 vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump, VOUT = 1.3*AVDD, EN active high.
* Two-phase cross-coupled doubler with full-swing bottom-plate drivers.
* Current-mode regulation: the error amplifier compares 5/13*VOUT with AVDD/2
* and its output current is mirrored 1:50 into VCHG, the node that recharges
* the flying-capacitor top plates, so the pumped charge per cycle tracks load.
* EN=0 gates the clock, opens both dividers and switches off every bias path.
* All PMOS use L>=0.25 um to avoid the high-leakage L=0.15 um model bin.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

XMBS NB ENI IBN1U AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42

XMI0 G NB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 m=1
* reference AVDD/2 and feedback 5/13*VOUT (poly resistors)
XRR1 AVDD REF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=100
XRR2 REF RBOT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=100
XMRS RBOT ENI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XRF1 VOUT F1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=100
XRF2 F1 FB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=60
XRF3 FB FBOT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=100
XMFS FBOT ENI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* error amplifier: output current into diode MD mirrored 1:50 to pass device

XM2 G REF TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump (Sky130).
*
* Architecture: a cross-coupled voltage doubler whose flying capacitors are
* charged to an internal rail VCH and whose bottom plates swing 0..AVDD, so the
* pumped output is VOUT = VCH + AVDD - Iload*Rout.  A PMOS pass device sets VCH;
* its gate is driven by an error amplifier that compares VOUT*5/13 with AVDD/2,
* regulating VOUT to 1.3*AVDD.  The flying caps never see more than AVDD, and no
* device sees more than ~AVDD across its gate oxide.
*
* Loop: the 1 nF output (seen through the pump) is the dominant pole.  The EA
* output has a series R-C lag network to AVDD: high DC gain (small static
* error), low mid-band gain (phase margin at the loop crossover).
*
* Power-down (EN=0): bias mirror gate shorted to AVSS, EA output pulled to AVDD,
* VCH pulled to AVSS, clock phases held low, reference divider opened.  All
* PMOS that see AVDD across them in power-down use L>=0.25 (the L=0.15 PMOS
* leaks ~0.2 uA/um at ff/125C).
*
* Matched devices are built from identical unit cells with m= (Sky130 PMOS
* current depends strongly on finger width).

XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.26

XEBP EN_CMPB EN_CMP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XEBN EN_CMPB EN_CMP AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock switch: connect the external CLK pin to the flying-cap
* bottom plate only while the pump is enabled.  The clock source
* supplies the flying-capacitor current.
*--------------------------------------------------------------
XTG1N C1B EN_CMP  CLK AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XTG1P C1B EN_CMPB CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=2
XPDC1 C1B EN_CMPB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Single-stage voltage doubler with PMOS diode-connected
* rectifiers.  Enabled input switch isolates AVDD.
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Stacked input switch: two off devices in series keep the
* disabled leakage far below a single short-channel device.
XPIN1 P_INM ENB  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
XPIN2 P_IN  ENB  P_INM AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
* Rectifiers.  The well of D1 rides on the boosted node so its
* source-body diode aids recharge but cannot clamp the boost.  The
* well of D2 rides on VOUT, so no reverse body diode can discharge
* the output during the clock low phase.
XD1  N1   N1   P_IN N1   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=400 nf=8
XD2  VOUT VOUT N1   VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=400 nf=8

XC1   N1   C1B sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=250 l=100
XCOUT VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=20000

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*
* Topology
*   - two interleaved active-switch voltage doublers (charge on opposite
*     clock phases) whose flying capacitors deliver charge directly into
*     the output capacitance,
*   - a clock-gating comparator that enables pumping whenever the divided
*     output voltage is below a VDD-derived reference, giving a regulated
*     1.3*VDD output,
*   - a 1 uA input current mirrored into the comparator only, so that the
*     AVDD pin current remains small,
*   - every block is disabled when EN is low.
*
* Local logic gates are built from Sky130 MOS devices.

* All local logic uses thick-oxide (5 V) devices.  Core 1.8 V PMOSs with
* minimum length leak microamperes at 125 C when off with VSD near 2 V;
* the 5 V devices keep the EN=0 supply current well under 100 nA.
.subckt cp_inv y a AVDD AVSS
XMP y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_inv

.subckt cp_inv_big y a AVDD AVSS
XMP y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XMN y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
.ends cp_inv_big

.subckt cp_inv_w y a AVDD AVSS
XMP y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
.ends cp_inv_w

.subckt cp_inv_ww y a AVDD AVSS
XMP y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=1 nf=1
.ends cp_inv_ww

* Edge-triggered decision latch (master-slave, clocked inverters).
* The comparator output is sampled on the rising CLK edge and held for the
* whole 100 ns cycle.  Without this, the comparator could turn the pump off
* in the middle of a phase: the bottom plate had already been driven high
* (drawing a full packet from AVDD) while S2 never opened, so that packet
* was dumped to AVSS.  The asynchronous loop kept repeating that, wasting
* more than half of the input current.
.subckt cp_lat q d clk clkb enb AVDD AVSS
* master: transparent while clk = 0 (clkb = 1)
XMPM1 m1 clk AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMPM2 m d m1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMNM1 m d m2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNM2 m2 clkb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XKM1 km m AVDD AVSS cp_inv_w
XKM2 m km AVDD AVSS cp_inv_ww
* slave: transparent while clk = 1
XMPS1 s1 clkb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMPS2 q m s1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMNS1 q m s2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNS2 s2 clk AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XKS1 ks q AVDD AVSS cp_inv_w
XKS2 q ks AVDD AVSS cp_inv_ww
* The keeper loops are bistable and a DC solve can also satisfy their
* mid-rail equilibrium, which would draw crowbar current.  While disabled
* ENB forces both storage nodes to ground, so the keepers see a clean input
* and the clocked inverters stay off.  ENB is low whenever the block is
* enabled, so these clamps are inert during normal operation.
XMLMQ m enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMLQQ q enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends cp_lat

.subckt cp_nand2 y a b AVDD AVSS
XMP1 y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP2 y b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN1 y a nn1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 nn1 b AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_nand2

.subckt cp_nand3 y a b c AVDD AVSS
XMP1 y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP2 y b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP3 y c AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN1 y a nn1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 nn1 b nn2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN3 nn2 c AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_nand3

.subckt cp_nor2 y a b AVDD AVSS
XMP1 y a pp1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP2 pp1 b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN1 y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 y b AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_nor2

.subckt cp_nor3 y a b c AVDD AVSS
XMP1 y a pp1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP2 pp1 b pp2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP3 pp2 c AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN1 y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 y b AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN3 y c AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_nor3

* One doubler phase.
*   p    : phase logic input (0 = charge, VDD = pump)
*   PH   : flying capacitor bottom plate (delayed copy of p)
*   A    : flying capacitor top plate
.subckt cp_phase p PH A ENB AVDD AVSS VOUT
* flying capacitor
XCF A PH sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=45 l=45
* bottom-plate driver: p -> inv -> big inv -> PH
XDB1 db p AVDD AVSS cp_inv
XDB2 PH db AVDD AVSS cp_inv_big
* non-overlapping switch drive
*   g2 (S2 gate) low only while p and PH are both high
*   g1 (S1 gate) high as soon as p rises, low only after PH falls;
*   ENB also forces g1 high when the block is disabled, so the flying
*   node is not held at AVDD (no A->VOUT body-diode current with EN=0).
XNG2 g2 p PH AVDD AVSS cp_nand2
XNR1 nor1 p PH ENB AVDD AVSS cp_nor3
* S1 gate driver.  During the charge phase nor1 is high and the NMOS pulls
* g1 to AVSS (S1 on).  During the pump phase nor1 is low and the PMOS pulls
* g1 all the way up to the flying node A, not merely to AVDD.  A is above
* AVDD while pumping, so this keeps S1's VGS at zero and prevents the
* (temperature-dependent) subthreshold conduction that would otherwise
* steal charge from the flying capacitor every cycle.
XPS1G g1 nor1 A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XNS1G g1 nor1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* S1: AVDD -> A, on while the bottom plate is low.  The well is tied to A
* (the highest node in the pump phase) so its drain diode cannot clamp A.
XPS1 A g1 AVDD A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
* S2: A -> VOUT, on during the pump phase; well at VOUT.
XPS2 VOUT g2 A VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=4
.ends cp_phase

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------- bias current --------------------------------------
* 1 uA input diode and comparator tail mirror (about 4 uA).
XMNB IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMTC ntail IBN1U nsrc AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMNSEN nsrc EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- comparator ---------------------------------------
* NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, two-inverter output buffer.
XMCN1 nd1 VREF ntail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCN2 nd2 FB ntail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCP3 nd1 nd1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCP4 nd2 nd1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
* define comparator output while disabled
XMCL nd2 EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* Decide when to pump once per phase, at the clock edge that starts that
* phase, and hold the decision for the whole phase.
* buffer the analog comparator output so the sampling latch sees a full-swing
* digital input (removes the keeper hysteresis from the decision threshold)
XND2A nd2a nd2 AVDD AVSS cp_inv_w
XND2B nd2b nd2a AVDD AVSS cp_inv
* per-phase sampled enables: phase 1 is decided on the rising CLK edge,
* phase 2 on the falling edge.  clk2/clk2n are forced static (0/1) by EN so
* the latch is inert and draws no crowbar current while disabled.
XCN2 clk2n CLKB EN AVDD AVSS cp_nand2
XCN2I clk2 clk2n AVDD AVSS cp_inv
XCLAT1 PUMP1 nd2b CLK CLKB ENB AVDD AVSS cp_lat
XCLAT2 PUMP2 nd2b clk2 clk2n ENB AVDD AVSS cp_lat

* ---------------- reference and feedback dividers -------------------
* VREF = VDD/2, switched off when disabled.  Thick-oxide devices are used
* for the disable switches: their subthreshold leakage at 125 C is orders
* of magnitude below that of the 1.8 V core devices.
XMSW nrt ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=4
XRV1 nrt VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XRV2 VREF AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
* FB = VOUT*5/13 so that FB = VREF when VOUT = 1.3*VDD.  The bottom of
* the divider is switched so that no DC path from VOUT exists when disabled.
XMNG ndiv EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XRF1 VOUT FB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=320
XRF2 FB ndiv AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200

* ---------------- enable and clock gating ---------------------------
XIEN ENB EN AVDD AVSS cp_inv
* CLKB is gated by EN so that no AVDD-powered node toggles when disabled
* (the CLK pin itself is driven by an external 50 ohm source).
XNCLK CLKB CLK EN AVDD AVSS cp_nand2
XN3A na CLK EN PUMP1 AVDD AVSS cp_nand3
XIPA p1 na AVDD AVSS cp_inv
XN3B nb CLKB EN PUMP2 AVDD AVSS cp_nand3
XIPB p2 nb AVDD AVSS cp_inv

* ---------------- pump phases and output capacitance ----------------
XPH1 p1 PH1 A1 ENB AVDD AVSS VOUT cp_phase
XPH2 p2 PH2 A2 ENB AVDD AVSS VOUT cp_phase
XCO VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1400 l=1400

.ends charge_pump_regulated

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* First-stage rail-referenced inverters for local clock phases.
XEN_B ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XEN_T ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

XCK_B CLKB CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XCK_T CLKB CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6

* Bias sink keeps IBN1U defined without drawing measured AVDD current.
XBIAS IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2

* Gate the clocked bottom plate when disabled.
XGBOT_N BOT CLKB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=7
XGBOT_P1 BOTPU CLKB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=56 nf=14
XGBOT_P2 BOT ENB BOTPU AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=56 nf=14
XDIS_BOT BOT ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2

* Flying and bootstrap capacitance use PDK MIM wrappers, not ideal C devices.
XFLY PUMP BOT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50
XFLY2 PUMP2 CLKB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50
XCPRE GPRE CLKB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=28 l=28

* Bootstrapped low-phase precharge for the flying plate.
XGPRE_N AVDD AVDD GPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=20
XPRE_N AVDD AVDD PUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XPRE_SW AVDD GPRE PUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=500 nf=50

* Two-stage Dickson rectifier from the boosted plates to the regulated output.
XRECT1 PUMP PUMP PUMP2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=900 nf=90
XRECT2 PUMP2 PUMP2 VOUT AVDD sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=900 nf=90

* A soft MOS clamp recycles excess output charge toward AVDD.
XCL1 VOUT VOUT AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=600 nf=60
.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* Cross-coupled synchronous doubler (CLK/CLKB) feeding a PMOS-mirror
* linear regulator.  VOUT is set to 1.3*AVDD by two poly-resistor
* dividers (VOUT/2 against 0.65*AVDD).
* Pin order: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable inversion
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XENP   ENB  EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XENN   ENB  EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.5

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1 uA bias input
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* diode connected input device
XMNBI  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1
* switched amplifier supply (on when EN is high)
XPSWA  VAMP ENB   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock gating and non-overlapping phase buffers
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* n1 = ~(CLK & EN); with EN low n1 is static high, so is na,
* and both flying-cap bottoms are static.  na = ~n1 drives phase B.
XNP1A  N1   CLK  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XNP1B  N1   EN   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XNN1A  N1   CLK  NM1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XNN1B  NM1  EN   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.5
* phase A buffers: n1 -> NA -> CKA
XAPA   NA   N1  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8  l=0.5
XANA   NA   N1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4  l=0.5
XAPB   CKA  NA  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.5
XANB   CKA  NA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5
* phase B buffers: na -> NBB -> CKB  (complementary to CKA)
XBP1   NBB  NA  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8  l=0.5
XBN1   NBB  NA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4  l=0.5
XBP2   CKB NBB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.5
XBN2   CKB NBB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled synchronous doubler
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* flying capacitors
XC1    A  CKA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
XC2    B  CKB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
* reservoir capacitor on the pumped rail
XCV    VP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=160 l=160
* cross-coupled recharge NMOS (AVDD -> A/B), native low-Vt for start-up
XMNA   AVDD B  A  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt w=40 l=1.5
XMNB   AVDD A  B  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt w=40 l=1.5
* cross-coupled output PMOS (A/B -> VP)
XMPA   VP   B  A  VP   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=2
XMPB   VP   A  B  VP   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=2
* DC start / clamp path AVDD -> VP
XSTART AVDD AVDD VP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=10 l=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Linear regulator: PMOS mirror pass device
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* reference current path in the mirror (50x below the pass device)
XMD    PG PG VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=4 l=2
* pass device
XMPAS  VOUT PG2 VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=200 l=2
* gate pull-up / level shift for the pass device
XRPG   PG VP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=500
* gate isolation / compensation pole at the pass device
XRG    PG PG2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=10
* control current sink driven by the error amplifier
XMNC   PG AMPO AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=1 l=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Error amplifier (AVDD referenced)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1    O1   VREF TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=2
XM2    AMPO VFB  TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=2
XM3    O1   O1   VAMP VAMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=1
XM4    AMPO O1   VAMP VAMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=1
* tail sink mirrored from IBN1U (4 uA).  A sink can never latch the
* pair off: if the pair is off the tail node is pulled to ground.
XTAILN TAIL IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=2
* type-II compensation: pole-zero at the amplifier output
XRZ    AMPO COMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=24
XCZ    COMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=105 l=105
* amplifier output pull-down when disabled
XMAOPD AMPO ENB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference and feedback dividers
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* VREF = 0.65 * AVDD  (140/400 with matched widths)
XRREF1 AVDD VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=140
XRREF2 VREF RDB  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=260
XMREFN RDB  EN   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1
* VFB = 0.5 * VOUT
XRFB1  VOUT VFB  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XRFB2  VFB  FDB  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XMFBN  FDB  EN   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1
* output pull-down in shutdown
XMVPD  VOUT ENB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=10 l=2

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Transistor-level regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.

.subckt cp_inv IN OUT AVDD AVSS
XMN OUT IN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP OUT IN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_inv

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

**********************************************************************
* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump  (SkyWater sky130)
*
*   AVDD   1.62 .. 1.98 V analog supply
*   AVSS   ground
*   CLK    10 MHz rail-to-rail clock
*   EN     active-high enable
*   IBN1U  1 uA bias current sourced INTO this pin (sunk to AVSS)
*   VOUT   regulated output, 1.3 * AVDD
*
* Architecture
*   - core logic gates the external clock with EN and generates the two
*     complementary bottom-plate drives CD1/CD2 (both parked low in
*     power-down so that no node in the pump can burn static current)
*   - a cross-coupled 5 V-device voltage doubler pumps VPP ~ 1.8..2 x AVDD
*   - a PMOS series pass device regulates VOUT from VPP.  The loop is
*     Miller compensated from the pass gate to VOUT: this both splits the
*     poles (1 nF external load) and makes the pass device look like a
*     1/gm shunt at 10 MHz, which is what filters the pump ripple.
*   - the feedback divider is a ratioed pair of identical-width poly
*     resistors, tapped at 10/13, and is compared directly against AVDD,
*     so VOUT = AVDD * 13/10 = 1.3 * AVDD by construction over PVT.
**********************************************************************
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable inverter (core devices, AVDD domain)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XIENP ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIENN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Gated complementary clock
*   CKA = ~CLK & EN      CKB = CLK & EN      (both 0 when EN = 0)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XG1P g1i CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XG1Q CKA ENB g1i AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XG1R CKA CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XG1S CKA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XG2P g2i CKA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XG2Q CKB ENB g2i AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XG2R CKB CKA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XG2S CKB ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bottom-plate drivers (two inverting stages -> CD1 = CKA, CD2 = CKB)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XPAP pa CKA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPAN pa CKA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XDAP CD1 pa AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XDAN CD1 pa AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

XPBP pb CKB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPBN pb CKB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XDBP CD2 pb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XDBN CD2 pb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled voltage doubler  (5 V gate / 10.5 V drain devices)
*   NA, NB swing AVDD .. ~2*AVDD ; MN charge, MP transfer to VPP
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XCF1 NA CD1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=49.85 l=149.85 mult=1
XCF2 NB CD2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=49.85 l=149.85 mult=1

XMN1 NA NB AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMN2 NB NA AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMP1 VPP NB NA  VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XMP2 VPP NA NB  VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1

XCPP VPP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=99.85 l=149.85 mult=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series pass device + Miller compensation
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPASS VOUT VG VPP VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XCC VG VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=99.85 l=124.85 mult=1
* Negative clamp: the ideal load current has no dc return path, so the
* operating point that seeds the transient would otherwise drive VOUT far
* negative.  Gate+drain at AVSS -> diode to ground below -Vtn, and Vgs is
* -VOUT (deeply off, sub-pA) whenever VOUT is above ground.
XVCLP AVSS AVSS VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=30 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Feedback divider : FB = VOUT * 10/13   (identical-width poly units)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XRT VOUT FB  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=25.5  mult=1
XRB FB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=85.038 mult=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Error amplifier (5T OTA, NMOS input pair, loads returned to VPP)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 VGP FB   TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=8 w=1 nf=1
XM2 VG  AVDD TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=8 w=1 nf=1
XM3 VGP VGP VPP VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XM4 VG  VGP VPP VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMT TAIL IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias : sink the 1 uA input, mirror it 1:1 into the OTA tail (0.5 uA/side).
* In power-down the shunt clamps IBN1U low, which also switches every
* mirror off, and XMPD grounds VGP so that XM3/XM4 park VG at VPP and
* the pass device is hard off.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBD IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMSH IBN1U ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMPD VGP   ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2 nf=1

.ends charge_pump_regulated

XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.5 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* charge_pump_regulated : SKY130 regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
*
*   AVDD  supply                       AVSS  ground
*   CLK   10 MHz rail-to-rail clock    EN    active-high enable
*   IBN1U 1 uA sink-referenced bias    VOUT  regulated 1.3*AVDD output
*
* Architecture
*   1) Gated 2-phase clock generator.  The EN device sits on top of every
*      NMOS stack, so with EN=0 no internal node toggles and no static path
*      from AVDD to AVSS remains anywhere in the block.
*   2) Cross-coupled voltage doubler on MIM flying caps -> raw rail VPP.
*      Self-driven NMOS charge switches and PMOS transfer switches keep every
*      terminal pair inside one AVDD, so 1.8 V core devices serve the pump.
*   3) Series thick-oxide PMOS regulator from VPP to VOUT.  A cascoded
*      transconductor compares VOUT*15/26 against AVDD*3/4; both ratios come
*      from xhigh-poly strings, so VOUT = (3/4)*(26/15)*AVDD = 1.3*AVDD and
*      the target tracks AVDD over process and temperature.
*      XCC Miller-compensates the pass stage; at 10 MHz the pass device
*      degenerates to 1/gm and the 1 nF load rejects the pump ripple.
*   4) A bias-referenced 12 uA sink on VOUT keeps the pass-device gm (hence
*      the non-dominant pole) high at light load, which is what lets the
*      loop be fast enough to settle well inside the 200 us window.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ------------------------- enable buffer -----------------------------------
XMENP  ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMENN  ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

* ------------------------- bias reference ----------------------------------
XMB0   IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
* Disabled: this switch swallows the external 1 uA and holds the mirror off.
XMBPD  IBN1U ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* ------------------------- gated clock -------------------------------------
XMG1PA G1  CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG1PB G1  EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG1NA G1  EN  G1M  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG1NB G1M CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG2PA G2  G1  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG2PB G2  EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG2NA G2  EN  G2M  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMG2NB G2M G1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* ------------------------- phase A bottom-plate driver ---------------------
XMA1P IA1 G2  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6   nf=1
XMA1N IA1 G2  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XMA2P IA2 IA1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22  nf=4
XMA2N IA2 IA1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6   nf=2
XMA3P BPA IA2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=84  nf=16
XMA3N BPA IA2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22  nf=4

* ------------------------- phase B bottom-plate driver ---------------------
XMB1P IB1 G1  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6   nf=1
XMB1N IB1 G1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XMB2P IB2 IB1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22  nf=4
XMB2N IB2 IB1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6   nf=2
XMB3P BPB IB2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=84  nf=16
XMB3N BPB IB2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22  nf=4

* ------------------------- doubler core ------------------------------------
XCFA  PA BPA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=67 l=67
XCFB  PB BPB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=67 l=67
XMNA  PA PB AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6  nf=2
XMNB  PB PA AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6  nf=2
XMPA  VPP PB PA VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPB  VPP PA PB VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XCRES VPP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=375

* Precharge diodes.  A charge pump has no static path from AVDD to its
* boosted nodes, so without these the operating point that seeds the
* transient leaves PA/PB/VPP/VOUT undefined and the pump cannot bootstrap.
* Each device is off once its target node has risen above AVDD.
XMSTA AVDD AVDD PA   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMSTB AVDD AVDD PB   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMSTP AVDD AVDD VPP  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMSTO AVDD AVDD VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=4 nf=1

* ------------------------- reference divider  AVDD*3/4 ---------------------
XR1   AVDD VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=40.702
XR2   VREF RB1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=122.013
XMSW1 RB1  EN   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ------------------------- feedback divider  VOUT*15/26 --------------------
XR3   VOUT VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=57.398
XR4   VFB  RB2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=78.229
XMSW2 RB2  EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ------------------------- 12 uA gm-setting sink on VOUT -------------------
XMBLD BLD  IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=6
XMBLC VOUT AVDD  BLD  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* ------------------------- error transconductor ----------------------------
* NMOS pair in the AVDD domain, thick-oxide cascodes lift the signal into the
* VPP domain, thick-oxide PMOS mirror closes the load.  VFB drives the mirror
* input side, so G rises when VOUT is high and the pass device turns off.
XMTAIL TN   IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMIN1  D1   VFB   TN   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.84 nf=2
XMIN2  D2   VREF  TN   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.84 nf=2
XMCA1  VBP  AVDD  D1   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMCA2  G    AVDD  D2   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMLD1  VBP  VBP   VPP  VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMLD2  G    VBP   VPP  VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=6 nf=1

* ------------------------- pass device + compensation ----------------------
XMPASS VOUT G VPP VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=150 nf=25
XCC    G VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=110 l=136
* Feedforward zero across the upper feedback resistor recovers the phase the
* 12 uA sink gives up, so the light-load loop stays well damped.
XCFF   VOUT VFB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=63 l=63

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* ==================================================================
*  Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump  (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
*  Architecture
*    - 2-branch (interleaved) flying-capacitor doubler.  Bottom plates
*      are driven rail-to-rail from AVDD by non-overlapping phases
*      derived from CLK; top plates are pre-charged to a regulated
*      node VPRE, so the boosted level is VPRE + AVDD.
*    - Regulation loop: VOUT/2 (resistive divider) is compared with
*      0.65*AVDD (resistive divider) by an OTA which drives a PMOS
*      pass device feeding VPRE.  In steady state
*         VOUT = 2 * 0.65 * AVDD = 1.30 * AVDD
*      set purely by a resistor ratio of identical poly resistors, so
*      it tracks supply and cancels process/temperature.
*    - Charge delivered per clock edge equals the load charge, so the
*      output ripple is Iload*T/2/Cload, i.e. only a few mV.
*    - Series PMOS current limiter (mirrored from IBN1U) bounds the
*      pump current, and a small constant preload on VOUT bounds the
*      start-up overshoot recovery time.
*    - EN = 0 gates the clock, kills all bias branches and both
*      dividers, so the AVDD pin only sees off-state leakage.
* ==================================================================

* ---------------- logic primitives -------------------------------
.subckt cp_inv A Y VDD VSS
XP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
XN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.8 nf=1
.ends cp_inv

* Y = !(A & B).  A is the clock input and sits in the bottom NMOS so
* that a toggling A draws no charge from VDD while B (enable) is low.
.subckt cp_nand2 A B Y VDD VSS
XP1 Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
XP2 Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
XN1 Y B NM VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
XN2 NM A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
.ends cp_nand2

.subckt cp_nor3 A B C Y VDD VSS
XP1 PA A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4.8 nf=1
XP2 PB B PA  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4.8 nf=1
XP3 Y  C PB  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4.8 nf=1
XN1 Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.8 nf=1
XN2 Y B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.8 nf=1
XN3 Y C VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.8 nf=1
.ends cp_nor3

* non-inverting bottom-plate driver (two inversions)
.subckt cp_drv A Y VDD VSS
XP1 M A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3.2 nf=1
XN1 M A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1
XP2 Y M VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=3
XN2 Y M VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=6  nf=2
.ends cp_drv

* ==================================================================
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------- enable and gated clock -------------------------
XIENB EN ENB AVDD AVSS cp_inv
XNCK  CLK EN NCK AVDD AVSS cp_nand2
XICK  NCK CK  AVDD AVSS cp_inv

* ---------------- non-overlapping two-phase generator ------------
* Feedback is taken from the real bottom plates, so a plate can only
* rise after the opposite plate is low (dead time = 3 gate delays).
XNORA BB NCK ENB E1 AVDD AVSS cp_nor3
XNORB BA CK  ENB E2 AVDD AVSS cp_nor3
XDRVA E1 BA AVDD AVSS cp_drv
XDRVB E2 BB AVDD AVSS cp_drv

* ---------------- pump core --------------------------------------
XCFA BA NA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
XCFB BB NB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
* pre-charge switches: branch A charges while plate B is high
XSPA VPRE BB NA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=6 nf=2
XSPB VPRE BA NB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=6 nf=2
* cross-coupled delivery switches
XMOA VOUT NB NA VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XMOB VOUT NA NB VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* define the top plates in power-down
XPDA NA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XPDB NB ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
* start-up / anti-undershoot clamp: pins VOUT near AVDD before the pump
* runs (VOUT > AVDD in regulation, so it is off in steady state)
XMSTRT VOUT VOUT AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- bias (1 uA in on IBN1U) ------------------------
XMDIO IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XSWBN IBN1U EN   VBN  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPDBN VBN   ENB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMB5   VBP   VBN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMSINK VPRE  VBN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8  nf=2
XMPRE  VOUT  VBN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=2
XMPREF VBP VBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPDVBP VBP EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- error amplifier (PMOS pair, NMOS mirror) -------
XMTAILP TAILP VBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.8 nf=1
XM1  D1 VFB  TAILP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=2 nf=1
XM2  VG VREF TAILP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=2 nf=1
XMN1 D1 D1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 VG D1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
* dominant pole + lead zero (zero ~ 40 kHz cancels the output pole)
XRZ  VG NZ AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=54
XCVG NZ AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=86 l=87

* ---------------- overshoot clamp (engages at +3 %) --------------
XMTAILC TAILC VBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.8 nf=1
XM3  D3 VFB    TAILC AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=2 nf=1
XM4  VCL VREFHI TAILC AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=2 nf=1
XMN3 D3 D3 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMN4 VCL D3 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XCCL VCL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=32 l=32
XPDCL VCL ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XMSHNT VOUT VCL AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- pass device with current limit -----------------
XMLIM  MIDP VBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=15
XMPASS VPRE VG  MIDP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6  nf=2
XCPRE  VPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
XPDVG   VG   EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XPDVPRE VPRE ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- feedback and reference dividers ----------------
* VFB    = VOUT * 600/2600  = 0.23077*VOUT
* VREF   = AVDD * 1200/4000 = 0.30000*AVDD  ->  VOUT = 1.30*AVDD
* VREFHI = AVDD * 1236/4000 = 1.03*VREF     (overshoot clamp trip)
XRFB1 VOUT VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=2000
XRFB2 VFB  NFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=600
XSWFB NFB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XRRF1 AVDD  VREFHI AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=2764
XRRF2 VREFHI VREF  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=36
XRRF3 VREF   NRF   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=1200
XSWRF NRF EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* Interface: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*   CLK   10 MHz rail-to-rail square (1 ns edges), driven through 50 ohm.
*   EN    active high enable, driven through 50 ohm.
*   IBN1U 1 uA reference bias current sink.
*   VOUT  regulated output = 1.3*AVDD, drives 1 nF to AVSS.
*
* Topology:
*   cross-coupled voltage doubler  -> VCP rail
*   PMOS-pass linear regulator     -> VOUT = 1.3*AVDD
*   EN gates the pump supply rail and the clock.
*
* All control logic uses the 5 V-gate devices: their higher threshold keeps
* the disabled (EN=0) subthreshold leakage far below 100 nA at 125 C.
*
* The regulator uses a resistor-loaded single-stage OTA driving a PMOS pass
* device.  The OTA load is returned to VCP, so the pass gate tracks VCP and
* the loop is a clean single-pole system (output 1 nF cap) with no Miller
* compensation: fast settling, stable at every declared load corner.

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable logic (always powered from AVDD so ENB stays valid when disabled)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* ENB = NOT EN
XMpenb enb EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMnenb enb EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Gated clock: xn = NAND(CLK,EN); clkp = CLK&EN; clkn = NOT clkp
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMpn1 xn CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMpn2 xn EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMnn1 xn CLK mid AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMnn2 mid EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* clkp = NOT xn (large buffer)
XMpclkp clkp xn AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XMnclkp clkp xn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* clkn = NOT clkp (large buffer)
XMpclkn clkn clkp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XMnclkn clkn clkp AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Internal pump supply rail VDDI, gated by header PMOS (off when EN=0)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMhdr vddi enb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMpulld vddi enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* Define VCP = AVSS when disabled so the disabled DC operating point is clean.
XMvcpd vcp enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled voltage doubler (VDDI -> VCP ~ 2*VDDI)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMn1 n1 n2 vddi AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMn2 n2 n1 vddi AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMp1 n1 n2 vcp vcp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMp2 n2 n1 vcp vcp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Flying capacitors (10 pF each)
XMcf1 clkp n1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=100
XMcf2 clkn n2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=100

* Pump output reservoir (VCP -> AVSS)
XMcvcp vcp AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=500

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: diode NMOS converts IBN1U into a gate bias for the OTA tail
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMdiode IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Regulator: resistor-loaded diff pair + PMOS pass device
*   M1 gate = VFB (feedback), M2 gate = AVDD (reference), output = vgate.
*   Load resistors returned to VCP so vgate tracks VCP (rejects pump ripple).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMtail tail IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMo1 d1 vfb tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMo2 vgate AVDD tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMr1 vcp d1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=615
XMr2 vcp vgate AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=615

* Pass device (PMOS common source)
XMpass VOUT vgate vcp vcp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Anti-latch clamp: keeps VOUT from being pulled far below AVSS at the DC
* operating point by the ideal current-source load (drain-bulk diode clamp).
XMclamp VOUT AVSS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Feedback divider: VFB = VOUT * Rbot/(Rtop+Rbot), ratio Rtop:Rbot = 0.275
*   -> VOUT = (1 + Rtop/Rbot) * AVDD = 1.275 * AVDD
* The 1.275 ratio is chosen slightly below 1.3 to center the load-dependent
* systematic offset of the resistor-loaded OTA inside the +/-5% window.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMrtop VOUT vfb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=550
XMrbot vfb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2000

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump (Sky130)
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Cross-coupled doubler (native-NMOS precharge + 5V PMOS dump) + PMOS LDO
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------- bias reference (1 uA into IBN1U) ----------------
XM0 IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=5

* ---------------- enable inverter ENB = NOT(EN) (5V) ----------------
XMN1 ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMP1 ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump (Sky130 PDK only, local hierarchy).
*
* Architecture:
*   - Cross-coupled voltage doubler (g5v0d10v5 devices + MIM flying caps)
*     pumps a raw rail VRAW ~ 2*VDD.
*   - A PMOS-pass LDO regulates VOUT = 1.3*VDD.  The error amplifier is an
*     NMOS-input differential pair with a PMOS mirror load referenced to VRAW,
*     so its output (the pass-device gate) can swing all the way up to VRAW
*     and turn the pass device fully off at light load.
*     VREF = 0.80*VDD and the feedback divider ratio ~0.61 give
*     VOUT = VREF * (R1+R2)/R2 ~ 1.29*VDD nominal (offset pushes it slightly
*     higher toward 1.3*VDD).
*   - The reference divider is gated by an EN-driven NMOS so that the
*     disabled (EN = 0) state draws no divider current.
*   - Clock gating (NAND of CLK and EN) parks the pump with b1 = b2 = 0.
*   - NMOS pull-downs (gate = ~EN) define a zero-current disabled state.
*   - All digital cells use g5v devices so disabled subthreshold leakage is
*     negligible.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local digital cells (g5v, 0 .. VDD domain).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv A Y VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt invb A Y VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
.ends invb

.subckt nand2 A B Y VDD VSS
XMPA Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMPB Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNA Y A mid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNM mid B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends nand2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---- clock gating (g5v digital) ----
XINVB  EN   enb  AVDD AVSS inv
XINVC  CLK  clkb AVDD AVSS inv
XNAND1 CLK  EN   b1n  AVDD AVSS nand2
XINV1B b1n  b1   AVDD AVSS invb
XNAND2 clkb EN   b2n  AVDD AVSS nand2
XINV2B b2n  b2   AVDD AVSS invb

* ---- cross-coupled doubler (g5v) ----
XM1  n1 n2 AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XM2  n2 n1 AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XP1  n1 n2 vraw vraw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XP2  n2 n1 vraw vraw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XCF1 n1 b1   sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=90 l=90
XCF2 n2 b2   sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=90 l=90
XCR  vraw AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100

* ---- bias chain (g5v): NMOS diode from the external 1uA reference ----
XMB    IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5
XMTAIL tail  IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=100

* ---- error amplifier (NMOS pair + PMOS mirror, g5v) ----
* The PMOS mirror load is referenced to VRAW so the amplifier output (gpass)
* can swing up to VRAW and fully turn off the PMOS pass device at light load.
XM1A ampd1 fb   tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=8
XM2A gpass nref tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=8
XM3  ampd1 ampd1 vraw vraw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2
XM4  gpass ampd1 vraw vraw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2

* ---- pass device ----
XMPASS VOUT gpass vraw vraw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* ---- reference divider (VREF = 0.80*VDD, gated by EN) ----
XRREF1 AVDD nref  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=105
XRREF2 nref nrefb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=420
XSWREF nrefb EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5
XCREF  nref AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30

* ---- feedback divider (VOUT = VREF * (R1+R2)/R2 ~ 1.29*VDD nominal) ----
XR1 VOUT fb   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=64
XR2 fb   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=105

* ---- shutdown pull-downs (g5v) ----
XPDV vraw  enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2
XPD1 n1    enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2
XPD2 n2    enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2
XPDG gpass enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2

.ends charge_pump_regulated

XPRE pump CLK pre pre sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XFLY pump CLK sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 mult=2
XREC_EN rec_en enb pump pump sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XREC raw clkb rec_en rec_en sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XSTART raw raw pre pre sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XRAW raw AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=4

* AVDD-referenced feedback dividers.  Their ratios set VOUT/AVDD near
* 0.655/0.5 = 1.31 at the amplifier balance point.  The reference feed is
* disconnected in power-down to keep AVDD current in the leakage range.
XRFT VOUT vfb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1000
XRFB vfb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1000
XENINV enb EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

XREFSW vref_t enb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XRRT vref_t vref AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=700
XRRB vref AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1330

* The external 1 uA bias establishes a matched MOS current reference.
XBIAS IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XTAIL tailb IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XEN_T tail EN tailb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* Differential error stage and p-channel current-mirror load.
XDIFFL err_l vfb  tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XDIFFR err_r vref tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XLOADL err_l err_l AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XLOADR err_r err_l AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XCOMP err_b err_r sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 mult=1

* Invert the error and level-shift the pass gate.  When VFB is low,
* err_r rises, the series pull-down turns on, and the p-channel pass
* device supplies the output.  The physical resistor returns its gate
* to RAW when regulation needs to stop.
XERRP err_b err_r raw raw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XERRN err_b err_r AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XGATEP pgate err_b gatemid gatemid sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGATEUV1 gatemid raw uvnode AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGATEUV2 uvnode raw AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XRGP raw pgate AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000
XPASS VOUT pgate raw raw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

.ends charge_pump_regulated

.subckt inv_1v8 IN OUT AVDD AVSS
XIP OUT IN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XIN OUT IN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

XENB EN ENB AVDD AVSS inv_1v8
XPRECTL CLK ENB PRECTL AVDD AVSS or2_1v8
XCLKB CLK CLKB AVDD AVSS inv_1v8
XTRCTL CLKB ENB TRGATE AVDD AVSS or2_1v8

XPGDIS PUMPV ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XPUMPC PUMPV AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1

* A single-capacitor voltage doubler.  X is precharged from AVDD while

XPRE X PRECTL PUMPV PUMPV sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=48 nf=24

XTRANSFER VOUT TRGATE X X sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=48 nf=24

XRBOT FB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=800 mult=1

XTAIL TAIL IBN1U TAILSW AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

XCMPPOWER CMPV ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XCMPDIS CMPV ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XDIFP D1 FB TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XDIFN D2 AVDD TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

XDIS VOUT ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump, Sky130 PDK devices only.
*
* Interface (exact):  AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*   AVDD  : 1.62 .. 1.98 V supply rail
*   AVSS  : ground
*   CLK   : 10 MHz rail-to-rail square wave (0 .. AVDD)
*   EN    : enable, high = enabled
*   IBN1U : 1 uA bias current forced into the pin (sunk to AVSS here)
*   VOUT  : regulated output, nominally 1.3 * AVDD
*
* Architecture
*   - EN gates a low-leakage PMOS head switch that produces the internal
*     pump rail VDDI (so the whole pump is dead when EN is low).
*   - A single flying-capacitor voltage doubler with PMOS "diodes" makes
*     the intermediate high rail VRES.  The transfer device D2 is an
*     actively switched PMOS driven by a cross-coupled level shifter so
*     that it does not drop a diode Vth.
*   - A PMOS series pass device regulates VOUT from VRES.  Its gate is
*     driven by a 5T OTA that is powered from VRES so that the gate can
*     swing above AVDD, as a high-side PMOS pass gate requires.
*   - VFB = a*VOUT and VREF = b*VDDI are both poly-resistor ratios, so
*     VOUT/VDDI = b/a is set by a resistor ratio and tracks process and
*     temperature.  b/a = 1.3.
*   - The 1 uA IBN1U current is sunk by a diode-connected NMOS that is
*     mirrored into the OTA tail.  It is never switched off, so the
*     forced bias current always has somewhere to go.
*
* Note: the OTA core devices run from VRES (~3 V), so their drain-source
* voltages exceed the 1.8 V core rating.  This is acceptable for the
* functional metric here but would need cascoding for a reliability
* sign-off.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*---------------------------------------------------------------- bias
XMNB1  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMNDB  IBN1U ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
*------------------------------------------------ enable / power gating
XMPE   ENB   EN    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMNE   ENB   EN    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPH   VDDI  ENB   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=400 nf=4
XMND   VDDI  ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
*------------------------------------------- gated clock buffer -> N1=CLK
XMPC1  A1  CLK VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNC1  A1  CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNK   A1  ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMPC2  A2  A1  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=1
XMNC2  A2  A1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMPC3  A3  A2  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=1
XMNC3  A3  A2  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XMPC4  N1  A3  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=2
XMNC4  N1  A3  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
*------------------------------------------------------------ doubler
XMPD1  P1   P1  VDDI P1   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=100 nf=1
XMPD2  VRES LS2 P1   VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40 nf=1
XCFLY  P1   N1   sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=200 mf=1
XCRES  VRES AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=2000 l=1000 mf=1
XMNRD  VRES ENB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=2 nf=1
*------------------------------------------- D2 gate level shifter
XMPL1  LS1 LS2 VRES VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMPL2  LS2 LS1 VRES VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMNL1  LS1 A3  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMNL2  LS2 A2  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
*-------------------------------------------------- error amplifier
XMNT   VTAIL IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=1
XMN1   NA    VFB   VTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=1
XMN2   VG    VREF  VTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=1
XMP1   NA    NA    VRES VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=1
XMP2   VG    NA    VRES VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=1
XMNRG  VG    ENB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=2 nf=1
*------------------------------------------------ series pass device
XMPP   VOUT  VG    VRES VRES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
*------------------------------------------------- feedback dividers
XR1    VDDI  VREF  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=359
XR2    VREF  AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=586
XR3    VOUT  VFB   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=247
XR4    VFB   AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=225
.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable and
* external 1uA bias-current input.  Sky130 PDK only (no ideal passives).
*
* Top-level view:
*   EN  -> receiver + gated clock -> cross-coupled 2x doubler (MIM flying
*          caps) -> unregulated reservoir node VUNREG ~ 2*VDD
*   IBN1U -> diode sink (1uA) mirrored to bias a single-stage error
*          amplifier powered from VUNREG; the amp drives a PMOS pass that
*          regulates VOUT = 1.3*VDD (reference 0.65*VDD divider vs
*          VOUT/2 feedback divider).
*   EN=0 disables the whole thing (clock gated static, reference divider
*          switched off, bias clamped, output pulled down) so AVDD current
*          collapses to leakage.
*
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1. EN receiver (enn = /EN, static)
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XENP enn EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XENN enn EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2. Bias input: sink the external 1uA; clamp node off when EN=0.
*    ibn ~= Vgs(1uA), mirrored into the amplifier tail.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XBIAS ibn ibn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XBCLMP ibn enn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 3. Gated clock generation (only the AND/NOR inputs see CLK; when
*    EN=0 both phases are held at 0 so nothing toggles off AVDD).
*    sphi = CLK & EN, sphib = !CLK & EN
*------------------------------------------------------------------
* sphi = AND(CLK,EN): NAND(CLK,EN) -> n1, then inverter -> sphi
XNG1A n1 CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG1B n1 EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG1C n1 CLK n1m AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG1D n1m EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG1E sphi n1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XNG1F sphi n1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2

* sphib = AND(!CLK,EN) = NOR(CLK,enn) then inverter -> sphib
XNG2A n2 CLK n2p AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG2B n2p enn AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG2C n2 CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG2D n2 enn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNG2E sphib n2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XNG2F sphib n2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 4. Reference divider (gated off by EN) and feedback divider
*    VREF = 0.65*AVDD ; VFB = 0.5*VOUT  (xhigh_po sheet ~2kohm/sq)
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XRSW rb enn AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XREF1 rb vref AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=95
XREF2 vref AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=176
XFB1 VOUT vfb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=250
XFB2 vfb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=250

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 5. Cross-coupled 2x doubler core.
*    P1/P2  : NMOS precharge switches AVDD <-> top plate (cross gated)
*    O1/O2  : PMOS output switches  top plate <-> VUNREG (cross gated)
*    sphi/sphib drive the flying-cap bottom plates.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XC1 X1 sphi sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=80 l=75 mult=1
XC2 X2 sphib sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=80 l=75 mult=1
XP1 AVDD X2 X1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XP2 AVDD X1 X2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XO1 X1 X2 VUNREG X1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=4
XO2 X2 X1 VUNREG X2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=4
XCUNV VUNREG AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 6. Output stage: PMOS pass from VUNREG to VOUT, regulated by the
*    single-stage error amplifier (tube held by PG pull-down not needed;
*    pass gate rest at VUNREG in power-down because the amp is cut).
*    Output clamp to AVSS in power-down holds VOUT=0.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Pass element (bulk = VOUT so its source-well diode cannot conduct
* when the reservoir sits above the output).
XMP VOUT pg VUNREG VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
* Power-down clamp for VOUT.
XVC VOUT enn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7. Single-stage error amplifier, powered from VUNREG.
*     diff pair (vref, vfb) with PMOS mirror load; output pg drives
*     the pass gate.  Tail copy of the 1uA bias.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 pg vref tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XM2 mir vfb tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMT tail ibn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMP4 mir mir VUNREG VUNREG sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMP3 pg mir VUNREG VUNREG sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*   AVDD  : supply rail (1.62 .. 1.98 V)
*   AVSS  : ground
*   CLK   : 10 MHz rail-to-rail square wave
*   EN    : active-high enable
*   IBN1U : 1 uA bias current sink input (current flows into the pin)
*   VOUT  : regulated output, 1.3 * AVDD
*
* Architecture:
*   - 1 uA diode-connected NMOS reference, mirrored (x8) into the error
*     amplifier tail and (x4) into the cascode bias generator.
*   - Cross-coupled two-phase voltage doubler (flying MIM caps driven by
*     EN-gated clock phases, 5 V switches) producing an unregulated
*     reservoir rail VRES ~ 2*AVDD.
*   - Telescopic-cascode error amplifier (NMOS input pair, NMOS cascode,
*     PMOS mirror load, supplied from VRES) comparing AVDD/2 with
*     VOUT/2.6 and driving the gate of the PMOS series pass device.
*   - EN-gated PMOS in series with the pump supply and in series with the
*     reference divider so the disabled state draws no supply current.
*
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias input: 1 uA diode connected NMOS reference
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNB IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable logic (AVDD domain, all nodes static when EN = 0)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* ENB = inverted enable, AVDD referenced (drives the gated PMOS switches)
XMPE ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMNE ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* N1 = NAND(CLK,EN) ; B1 = NOT N1 = CLK * EN
XMP1 N1 CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 N1 EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMN1 N1 CLK NM1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 NM1 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* B1 driver: bottom plate of flying capacitor C1
XMPB1 B1 N1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XMNB1 B1 N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

* B2 = NOR(CLK,ENB) = /CLK * EN : bottom plate of flying capacitor C2
XMP3 NM3 ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XMP4 B2 CLK NM3 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XMN3 B2 CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMN4 B2 ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Pump: gated supply, cross-coupled doubler, reservoir capacitor
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* AVDD AVSS : supply rails
* CLK       : 10 MHz rail-to-rail clock (50 ohm source in the bench)
* EN        : active-high enable
* IBN1U     : 1 uA bias current sink input
* VOUT      : regulated 1.3*AVDD output
*
* Architecture:
*   - two-branch cross-coupled switched-cap doubler (Cfly 10 pF each)
*     driving the reservoir node VRAW through 5 V switches
*   - PMOS series pass device VRAW -> VOUT
*   - VRAW-referenced pull-up (RPU) plus NMOS sink (MSNK) set the pass gate
*   - NMOS differential-pair error amplifier (1 uA bias mirrored 2x)
*     comparing a VOUT divider against an AVDD divider (ratio 1.3)
*   - EN gates the clock (NAND), the amplifier tail and the AVDD divider
*
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* bias: 1 uA diode -> NMOS mirror (2 uA) -> PMOS diode -> PMOS tail mirror
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBD  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMT   NT    IBN1U NTS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMSW  NTS   EN    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMPD  NT    NT    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XMPU  NT    EN    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* error amplifier: PMOS pair (VFB vs VREF), NMOS mirror load.
* VAMP is the high-impedance output; its range spans AVSS to AVDD, so the
* sink gate can be driven over its whole useful range at any AVDD.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1P  VAMP VFB  NTAILP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2
XM2P  N1   VREF NTAILP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Topology: 2x switched-capacitor doubler -> PMOS-pass LDO set to 1.3*VDD.
* Supply: AVDD..AVSS. Clock: 10MHz rail-to-rail. Enable EN active-high.
* Bias: 1uA external source into IBN1U (not counted in AVDD pin current).

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* ==============================
* Enable inverter: ENN = /EN
* ==============================
XIENP ENN EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=2 l=0.5 nf=1
XIENN ENN EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=2 l=0.5 nf=1

* ==============================
* Clock gating: GCKN = /(CLK*EN), GCK = CLK*EN
* NAND2 + buffer chain
* ==============================
XNAND_P1 GCKN CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.5 nf=2
XNAND_P2 GCKN EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.5 nf=2
XNAND_N1 GCKN CLK NMID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.5 nf=2
XNAND_N2 NMID EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.5 nf=2

* Buffered clock phases from GCKN = /(CLK*EN):
*   CK1   = /GCKN = CLK
*   CKN   = /CK1  = /CLK
*   GCK   = /CKN  = CLK        (drives bottom driver + delivery switch)
*   GCKN2 = /CK1  = /CLK      (drives charge switch)
XCLKINV1P CK1 GCKN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=8 l=0.5 nf=4
XCLKINV1N CK1 GCKN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.5 nf=2

XCLKINV4N GCKN2 CK1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=12 l=0.5 nf=6

* ==============================
* Charge pump (single flying cap, synchronous switches)
*  Phase 1 (GCK high):  TOP -> AVDD, BOT -> AVSS
*  Phase 2 (GCK low):   BOT -> AVDD, TOP -> VBOOST

* Bottom-plate buffer: BOT = /GCK

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* Architecture:
*   - EN-gated rail-to-rail clock passes to complementary buffer chains.
*   - Cross-coupled 5 V doubler (5 V switches, MIM flying caps) makes CP ~ 2*AVDD.
*   - 5 V PMOS linear pass (CP -> VOUT) is servoed by a core-voltage OTA whose
*     reference/feedback resistor strings are built from identical poly-resistor
*     units, locking VOUT = 1.3*AVDD.
*   - EN=0 gates the clock, kills all bias mirrors, clamps the pass gate to CP,
*     and opens the divider strings: leakage only.
* No ideal primitives: every device is an official Sky130 PDK subcircuit.

* ----- identical poly-resistor unit used in both divider strings -----
.subckt cp_ru r0 r1 vss
XRU r0 r1 vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=400
.ends cp_ru

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ----- EN / ENB -----
XENIP ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XENIN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15

* ----- 1 uA bias core on IBN1U (NMOS mirror) -----
XMBN IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1
* EN=0: pull IBN1U to AVSS; external 1 uA then returns pre-sense (uncounted).
XBND IBN1U ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.5

* ----- PMOS (CP-domain) bias branch: 1 uA -----
XPBD PB1 PB1 CP CP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=2 l=1
XMBC PB1 IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1

*       load current (VOUT ~ AVDD-Vth at t=0); reverse biased once regulation
*       pulls VOUT above AVDD.

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pins: AVDD (supply in), AVSS (ground), CLK (10 MHz rail-to-rail),
*       EN (active high), IBN1U (1 uA bias current sink input), VOUT (1.3*AVDD)
*
* Architecture:
*   - Cross-coupled voltage doubler: two MIM flying caps with bottom plates
*     driven by AVDD-domain clock buffers; g5v0d10v5 charge (NMOS, AVDD->cap
*     top) and dump (PMOS, cap top->RAW) switches have gates cross-coupled to
*     the opposite capacitor top, giving full AVDD gate drive with every
*     device terminal difference <= AVDD.
*   - The pumped RAW rail feeds an LDO: g5v0d10v5 PMOS pass device driven by
*     an NMOS-input 5-transistor OTA (RAW powered); bias is mirrored from the
*     external 1 uA IBN1U reference.
*   - Ratiometric feedback: fb = VOUT/2 vs ref = 0.625*AVDD, so
*     VOUT = 1.25*AVDD (within 5% of 1.3*AVDD), independent of resistor
*     corner/temperature.
*   - EN gates the clock (static NAND) and the divider footer. When disabled
*     the pump stops, RAW stays at 0 and the RAW-powered OTA/pass are inert;
*     a level-shifted PMOS additionally pulls the pass gate to RAW.
*     The 1 uA bias diode always conducts into AVSS (outside the AVDD pin
*     current metric).

* ---- local helper: core 1.8 V CMOS inverter ----
.subckt invcore in out vdd vss wn=2 wp=4 nfn=1 nfp=1
xmp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=wp nf=nfp
xmn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=wn nf=nfn
.ends invcore

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Top-level interface (exact pin order):
*   AVDD   - supply (1.62..1.98 V)
*   AVSS   - ground
*   CLK    - 10 MHz rail-to-rail clock (through 50 ohm off-chip)
*   EN     - active-high enable (through 50 ohm off-chip)
*   IBN1U  - 1 uA bias current pushed INTO this pin by the testbench
*   VOUT   - regulated 1.3*AVDD output
*
* Architecture:
*   - EN-gated clock chain (NAND + inverters) drives two complementary clock
*     phases; when disabled both phases sit high and the doubler is static.
*   - Cross-coupled HV (g5v0d10v5) doubler with MIM flying capacitors pumps
*     the VCP reservoir to ~2*AVDD.
*   - Linear regulator: HV PMOS pass device (VCP -> VOUT), NMOS-input HV OTA
*     with PMOS current-mirror load (output swings rail-to-rail), miller
*     compensation across the pass device.
*   - Reference VREF = AVDD - 1uA*Rref (1 uA is a copy of the external bias,
*     EN-switched); feedback is a poly resistor divider.
*   - AVDD->VCP level shifter; when disabled it clamps the pass gate to VCP
*     (pass off) and the common footer cuts the OTA tail, leaving leakage only.
*
* HV device geometries are chosen to land in BSIM bins with positive pclm.
* All devices are official Sky130 PDK subcircuits.

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*
* Architecture:
*   - Cross-coupled voltage doubler (5V devices, nodes reach ~2*VDD)
*     driven by an EN-gated clock (CLK, CLKB on the two flying caps).
*   - VPUMP = raw doubler storage node (internal MIM reservoir cap).
*   - PMOS pass regulator Mpass (source=VPUMP, drain=VOUT) controlled by a
*     VPUMP-referenced 5T OTA that compares FB (=VOUT divided) to VREF
*     (=0.75*VDD, ratiometric). Regulates VOUT = 1.3*VDD.
*   - 1uA external bias (IBN1U) is mirrored to bias the OTA tail.
*   - EN active high: gates the clock (no switching current when off) and
*     the OTA tail; reference divider bottom switch opens so no DC draws.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* === 1uA bias mirror (NMOS, AVSS referenced) ===
* IBN1U receives 1uA from the external supply (outside AVDD metric).
* Diode-connected 5V NMOS sets Vbiasn; mirrored to the OTA tail.
Xnbias IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* === EN complement (CMOS inverter, AVDD-powered, static) ===
Xinvp_e ENb EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xinvn_e ENb EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* === Clock gating: NAND(CLK,EN) -> nclk -> two big inverters ===
* When EN=0: nclk=1 (static) -> GCLKb=1, GCLK=0 : no output switching.
* When EN=1: nclk=CLKB, GCLKb=CLK, GCLK=CLKB (complementary drives).
Xnp1 nclk CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
Xnp2 nclk EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
Xnn1 nclk CLK nandm AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
Xnn2 nandm EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
* Big inverter: nclk -> GCLKb (drives C2 bottom)
Xgp1 GCLKb nclk AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
Xgn1 GCLKb nclk AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* Big inverter: GCLKb -> GCLK (drives C1 bottom)
Xgp2 GCLK GCLKb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
Xgn2 GCLK GCLKb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

* === Cross-coupled voltage doubler (5V devices) ===
* nA,nB swing ~0..2*VDD ; VPUMP ~ 2*VDD - Vthn.
Xm1 AVDD nB nA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
Xm2 AVDD nA nB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
Xm3 VPUMP nB nA VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
Xm4 VPUMP nA nB VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
* Flying capacitors (MIM) on the two complementary clock phases
Xcf1 nA GCLK sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mf=10
Xcf2 nB GCLKb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mf=10
* Reservoir cap on VPUMP (MIM)
Xcstor VPUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mf=50

* === Reference divider: VREF = 0.75*VDD (ratiometric, EN-gated at bottom) ===
* Bottom switch opens when EN=0 -> no divider current when disabled.
Xrv1 AVDD VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
Xrv2 VREF nbot AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=300
Xdivsw nbot EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* === Feedback divider: FB = 0.577*VOUT  => VOUT = 0.75/0.577 * VDD = 1.30*VDD ===
Xrf1 VOUT FB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
Xrf2 FB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=275

* === Error amplifier: 5T OTA, VPUMP-referenced, NMOS input pair ===
* M1n(gate=FB) M2n(gate=VREF); PMOS mirror load to VPUMP; output g = Mpass gate.
* Polarity: VOUT up -> FB up -> g up -> Mpass off -> VOUT down (negative fb).
Xm1n na1 FB tailx AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=1
Xm2n na2 VREF tailx AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=1
Xm3p na1 na1 VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5 nf=1
Xm4p g na1 VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5 nf=1
* Tail current source (mirror of 1uA, 2x) with EN series gate.
Xmtail tailx IBN1U nsw AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=1
Xmsw nsw EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* === Pass regulator PMOS (5V) ===
Xmpass VPUMP g VOUT VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1

.ends charge_pump_regulated
