* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump, Sky130 PDK.
*
* Architecture:
*   1. Cross-coupled doubler core (Pelliconi style): flying caps C1/C2 are
*      pushed by CLK / inverted-CLK (node Y), recharged from AVDD through the
*      EN-gated head switch (VDDP rail) via cross-coupled 5V NMOS, and deliver
*      to VCP through cross-coupled 5V PMOS.  The inverted clock is generated
*      from the clock pin itself with a switched reservoir (H node), so no
*      quiescent AVDD current is spent on bottom-plate drive.
*   2. LDO post-regulator: 1.8V PMOS pass (short channel, low effective Vth)
*      from VCP to VOUT with ratiometric feedback VOUT/2.6 vs AVDD/2, so
*      VOUT = 1.3*AVDD.  Pull-up current source and 5V NMOS pull-down drive
*      the pass gate; a wide 1.8V PMOS diode clamps |Vgs| of the pass.
*   3. 1 uA external bias (IBN1U) sets the OTA tail current through an
*      NMOS mirror gated by EN (VBN rail).
*   4. EN=0: head switch, bias mirror, both divider strings and the OTA are
*      cut off, leaving only pA-class junction/subthreshold leakage on AVDD.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*
* ---------------- enable inverter (long-L, pA-class leakage) ----------------
XINVD ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=1 nf=1
XINVU ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=1 nf=1
*
* ---------------- 1 uA bias mirror, gated onto VBN rail ---------------------
XDIOD IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XBGATE IBN1U EN VBN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XBPULL VBN ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
*
* ---------------- AVDD head switch feeding the doubler core ----------------
XHEAD VDDP ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
*
* ---------------- doubler core ----------------
* cross-coupled recharge switches (5V drain for the 2*VDD swing)
XNR1 X1 X2 VDDP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XNR2 X2 X1 VDDP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* cross-coupled deliverers to VCP (body on VCP: backflow-proof)
XDL1 VCP X2 X1 VCP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XDL2 VCP X1 X2 VCP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* flying capacitors (MIM, ~40 pF each)
XC1 X1 CLK sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=200
XC2 X2 Y sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=200
* VCP reservoir (~100 pF)
XCVCP VCP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=250
*
* ---------------- clock-powered inverted clock (H reservoir) ----------------
XPH H Y CLK H sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XPY Y CLK H H sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XNY Y CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XCH H AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=250
*
* ---------------- LDO pass device, clamp, and output stage ----------------
* pass: short-channel 1.8V PMOS (low effective Vth => low dropout)
XPASS VOUT VG VCP VCP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=50
* |Vgs| clamp: wide long-channel PMOS diode, always above the pass operating
* point (its Vth has no short-channel roll-off) and far below oxide limits
XVGC VG VG VCP VCP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=25
* pull-up current source from VCP (gate on AVDD)
XPU VG AVDD VCP VCP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=5 w=4.5 nf=1
* pull-down: 5V NMOS driven by the OTA output VZ
XPD VG VZ AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* Miller compensation across the pass
XCC VG VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=33
*
* ---------------- error OTA (on AVDD rail) ----------------
XTAIL TAILN VBN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=10
XN1 VZ VFB TAILN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XN2 PM VREF TAILN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XP1 PM PM AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XP2 VZ PM AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* defines VZ when disabled so the pull-down stays off
XPZ VZ ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
*
* ---------------- reference divider: VREF = AVDD/2 ----------------
XR1 AVDD VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000
XR2 VREF DSW1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000
XDSW1 DSW1 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=2 nf=1
*
* ---------------- feedback divider: VFB = VOUT/2.6 ----------------
XR3 VOUT VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1600
XR4 VFB DSW2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000
XDSW2 DSW2 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=2 nf=1
.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* 1 uA into IBN1U sets internal bias (mirrored; excluded from AVDD metric).
* Cross-coupled synchronous doubler builds ~2*VDD at RES; PMOS LDO regulates
* VOUT=1.3*VDD (fb=VOUT/2.6 vs ref=AVDD/2). EN gates bias + ref divider.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

*---- Bias: 1uA into IBN1U -> NMOS diode Mrefn (Vbn=IBN1U). Mnmirr (gate=Vbn,
* EN-series switch Msnw) biases PMOS diode Mrefp on RES rail -> Vbp. All
* high-side PMOS bias (M5) mirrored from Vbp, killed when EN=0. ----
XMrefn IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5
XMnmir VBP  IBN1U NSEN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5
XMnsw  NSEN EN   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10
XMrefp VBP  VBP  RES  RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=5

*---- Error amp stage1: PMOS-input diff pair, NMOS mirror load.
* M1 gate=REF (diode side), M2 gate=FB (output side). v1=M2/M4 drain.
* fb down -> v1 up. ----
XM1  D1  REF TAIL RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10
XM2  V1  FB  TAIL RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10
XM3  D1  D1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10
XM4  V1  D1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10
XM5  TAIL VBP RES  RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10
* weak v1 pull-down so M7 is off when amp is disabled.
XRV1 V1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=4740

*---- Error amp stage2: NMOS M7 pulls GATE down; PMOS current source M8
* (mirror of bias, gated by EN via Vbp) pulls GATE up for fast slew; Rpu is a
* weak keeper (start-up / power-down). v1 up -> M7 on -> GATE down -> Mp on. ----
XM7  GATE V1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=1
XM8  GATE VBP RES  RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=30
XRPU GATE RES AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=4740

*---- Pass PMOS LDO + nested-Miller comp (Cc1 inner around Mp, Cc2 outer) +
* min bleed for light-load stability. ----
XMP  VOUT GATE RES RES sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=400
XCC1 GATE VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=2500
XCC2 V1 VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=2500
XRBL VOUT AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=150

*---- Feedback divider: fb = VOUT/2.6 (Rtop:Rbot = 1.6:1). ----
XRF1 VOUT FB   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1520
XRF2 FB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=950

*---- Reference divider: ref = AVDD/2, gated by EN (PMOS switch, gate=ENB). ----
XRSW SWN ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
XRR1 SWN REF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=855
XRR2 REF AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=855
* ENB = inverter(EN).
XIVP ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10
XIVN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10

*---- Cross-coupled synchronous doubler. C1 bottom=CLK (ext), C2=CLKB (int).
* MC1/MC2 charge NA/NB from AVDD; MT1/MT2 deliver NA/NB to RES. ----
XC1  NA  CLK  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=500
XC2  NB  CLKB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=250
XCR  RES AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=1000
XMC1 NA  NB  AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50
XMC2 NB  NA  AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50
XMT1 NA  NB  RES  RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50
XMT2 NB  NA  RES  RES  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50
* CLKB inverter driving C2.
XIV2P CLKB CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40
XIV2N CLKB CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable, 1 uA bias input.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Architecture
*   Bias   : external 1 uA into IBN1U is sunk by a diode-connected NMOS and
*            mirrored up to the error-amp tail (gated by EN through XMSW).
*   Clock  : NAND(EN,CLK) -> CKG, then two inverter stages produce the two
*            complementary flying-cap bottom-plate drives PH1 (=CKG) and
*            NC (=~CKG).  With EN low, CKG is forced high so PH1 = AVDD and
*            NC = AVSS, which parks the pump in a non-conducting state.
*   Pump   : cross-coupled PMOS doubler.  Diode-free precharge devices
*            P_A/P_B (gate = own flying-cap bottom plate) recharge the flying
*            caps to AVDD; cross-coupled transfer devices T_A/T_B (gate = the
*            opposite flying-cap top plate) dump the boosted top plates into
*            VCAP, giving VCAP ~ 2*AVDD - eps.
*   Output : PMOS pass device from VCAP to VOUT.  MD is a diode-connected
*            PMOS from VCAP that level-shifts the gate down by |Vth|+Vov, so
*            MP acts as a current mirror of MD with ratio (W/L)MP/(W/L)MD.
*            MSINK (gate = amplifier output NA) closes the loop.
*   Loop   : 5T NMOS-input error amp compares VOUT/2 against 0.65*AVDD, i.e.
*            it forces VOUT = 1.3*AVDD exactly.  PMOS LVT mirror loads are
*            referenced to VDDI, a gated copy of AVDD.
*   Disable: EN low -> VDDI collapses (amp dead), XDIS pulls NA to AVSS so
*            MSINK and therefore MP turn off, and the reference divider is
*            opened by XRSW.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------- bias input ----------------
XMB0 IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2

* ---------------- enable inverter ----------------
XENP ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XENN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

* ---------------- gated internal rail ----------------
XVDP VDDI ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XVDN VDDI ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- clock gate : CKG = ~(CLK & EN) ----------------
XNDP1 CKG CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XNDP2 CKG EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XNDN1 CKG CLK NND AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3
XNDN2 NND EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3

* ---------------- flying-cap bottom-plate drivers ----------------
XIV1P NC CKG AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=20
XIV1N NC CKG AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=10
XIV2P PH1 NC AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=20
XIV2N PH1 NC AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=10

* ---------------- doubler core ----------------
XPA X1 PH1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
XPB X2 NC  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
XTA VCAP X2 X1 VCAP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
XTB VCAP X1 X2 VCAP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
XC1 X1 PH1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=5
XC2 X2 NC  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=5
XCV VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=20

* ---------------- pass stage and gate level shift ----------------
XMP  VOUT N1 VCAP VCAP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XMD  N1 N1 VCAP VCAP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMSINK N1 NA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.4 w=0.42 nf=1
XDIS NA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- error amplifier ----------------
XM1 ND1 VREF NTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM2 NA  VFB  NTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM3 ND1 ND1 VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XM4 NA  ND1 VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMT  NTAIL IBN1U NSW AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMSW NSW EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* ---------------- feedback divider : VFB = VOUT/2 ----------------
XRF1 VOUT VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2 l=175
XRF2 VFB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2 l=175

* ---------------- reference divider : VREF = 0.65*AVDD ----------------
XRSW NRT ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XRS1 VREF NRT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2 l=175
XRS2 VREF AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2 l=325

.ends charge_pump_regulated

XEN1 ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- phase generator ----------------
* NA = NAND(CLK, EN)
XAP1 NA CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XAP2 NA EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

XAN2 N1 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* PHI_A = AND(CLK, EN)
XBP1 PHI_A NA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=1

* =====================================================================
*  charge_pump_regulated : regulated 2x flying-cap charge pump
*  Process : Sky130 (sky130.lib.spice continuous models)
*
*  Signal path
*    AVDD -> 2x doubler -> VPUMP (~2*AVDD) -> PMOS pass -> VOUT
*    VOUT is servo-ed to 0.66*VPUMP by a 5T error amplifier whose
*    reference is a poly divider off VPUMP, so VOUT ~ 1.3*AVDD.
*
*  Clocking
*    CLK is level-restored and split into two non-overlapping phases.
*    Both phases are forced HIGH when EN is low, which opens every
*    pump switch and leaves VPUMP floating (no DC path to AVDD).
*    The high-side delivery switch is gate-bootstrapped above VPUMP so
*    an AVDD-referenced phase can open it.
* =====================================================================
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  local building blocks (fixed geometry, no ideal elements)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv_a in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv_a

.subckt inv_s in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=0.42 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv_s

.subckt inv_b in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0  nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0  nf=2
.ends inv_b

.subckt inv_c in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0  nf=4
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0  nf=4
.ends inv_c

.subckt nand3_a a b c out vdd vss
XPA out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPB out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPC out c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNA out a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNC n2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nand3_a

.subckt nor2_a a b out vdd vss
XPA out a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPB n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNA out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nor2_a

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  enable level restore
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XINV_EN  EN   ENA   AVDD AVSS inv_b
XINV_EN2 ENA  ENAN  AVDD AVSS inv_a

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  clock gate: transmission gate + pull-down kills all clock dynamic
*  power when EN = 0 (needed for the 100 nA disabled budget)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XTG_N  CKG CLK EN   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0  nf=2
XTG_P  CKG CLK ENA  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0  nf=4
XCKPD  CKG ENA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=1.0  nf=2

XCK1  CKG CKA AVDD AVSS inv_b
XCK2  CKA CKB AVDD AVSS inv_b

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  non-overlapping phase generator (both phases HIGH in the gap)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XNO1  CKA PHBDD ENAN PH  AVDD AVSS nand3_a
XNO2  CKB PHDD ENAN PHB AVDD AVSS nand3_a

XRD1  PH   PHDN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5000
XCD1  PHDN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 mult=1
XBD1  PHDN PHD  AVDD AVSS inv_s
XTD1  PHD  PHDD AVDD AVSS inv_b

XRD2  PHB   PHBDN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5000
XCD2  PHBDN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 mult=1
XBD2  PHBDN PHBD AVDD AVSS inv_s
XTD2  PHBD  PHBDD AVDD AVSS inv_b

XBUFP  PH   PHP  AVDD AVSS inv_c
XBUFPB PHB  PHPB AVDD AVSS inv_c

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  bootstrap drive H1/H2 : low during own charging phase AND during the
*  dead time, high during own delivery phase
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVPN  PHP  PHN  AVDD AVSS inv_a
XINVPBN PHPB PHBN AVDD AVSS inv_a
XH1  PHP  PHBN H1A AVDD AVSS nor2_a
XH2  PHPB PHN  H2A AVDD AVSS nor2_a
XBFH1A H1A H1X AVDD AVSS inv_a
XBFH1  H1X H1  AVDD AVSS inv_c
XBFH2A H2A H2X AVDD AVSS inv_a
XBFH2  H2X H2  AVDD AVSS inv_c

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  doubler branch 1   (flying cap C1 between P1 and N1)
*    charging  : PH high  -> S1A/S1C on, S1D off
*    delivering: PH low   -> S1D on, S1B bootstrapped on
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XS1A P1    PHPB AVDD  P1    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS1B P1    GB1  VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS1C N1    PHP  AVSS  N1    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS1D N1    PHP  AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XC1  P1    N1        sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=25 l=20 mult=1
XCB1 GB1   H1        sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=11 l=11 mult=1
XRB1 VPUMP GB1  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=400

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  doubler branch 2   (anti-phase)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XS2A P2    PHP  AVDD  P2    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS2B P2    GB2  VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS2C N2    PHPB AVSS  N2    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XS2D N2    PHPB AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XC2  P2    N2        sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=25 l=20 mult=1
XCB2 GB2   H2        sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=11 l=11 mult=1
XRB2 VPUMP GB2  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=400

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  bias from the supplied 1 uA reference
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XBDIO IBN1U IBN1U AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2  nf=1
XTAIL AVREF IBN1U TMSW  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XENSW TMSW  ENAN  AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4  nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  error amplifier: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, tail from VPUMP
*  M_AIN1 gate = VOUT (mirror side) so a zero-VOUT start-up pulls the
*  amp output low and turns the pass device on
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XAIN1 AMIDI VOUT   AVREF AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XAIN2 AVPOT VREF   AVREF AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XAIL1 AMIDI AMIDI  VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XAIL2 AVPOT AMIDI  VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XRGA  VPUMP AVPOT  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1500

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  pass device and reference divider
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XPASS VOUT AVPOT VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XRDIV1 VPUMP VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=340
XRDIV2 VREF  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=660

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  helpers
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Architecture: Dickson doubler with PMOS diodes (bulk=drain, floating n-well) + shunt regulator

* Bias subcircuit with enable control
.subckt cp_bias ibn1u ibias_p vref en vdd vss
* Enable switch + NMOS diode (sets reference Vgs for mirror)
XMNEN mn0_src en vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN0 ibn1u ibn1u mn0_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* NMOS mirror copies MN0 current into PMOS diode
XMN1 mp_drain ibn1u mn0_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* PMOS diode + mirror
XMPD mp_drain mp_drain vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMP0 ibias_p mp_drain vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
* DC sink for ibias_p (establishes operating point)
XMN_BIAS ibias_p ibias_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
* Enable pull-ups: force bias off when EN=0
XMPE1 mp_drain en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPE2 ibias_p  en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.5 nf=1
* VDD divider for reference (VDD/2)
XR1d vdd vref vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XR2d vref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
.ends cp_bias

* Non-overlapping clock generator with enable gating
.subckt cp_clkgen clk en clk_a clk_b vdd vss
* NAND gate
XMPP1 nand_a clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPP2 nand_a en  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNN1 nand_a clk nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNN2 nmid en  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Inverter
XMPI1 phi_a nand_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNI1 phi_a nand_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* 3-inverter delay chain
XMPI2 nd1 phi_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNI2 nd1 phi_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPI3 nd2 nd1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNI3 nd2 nd1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPI4 phi_a_d nd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNI4 phi_a_d nd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Buffer phi_a (drive pump cap)
XMPI7 clk_a phi_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNI7 clk_a phi_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* phi_b = NOT(phi_a_delayed)
XMPI5 clk_b phi_a_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNI5 clk_b phi_a_d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends cp_clkgen

* Dickson voltage doubler with PMOS diodes (bulk=drain, floating n-well)
* Each PMOS has its own n-well tied to its drain (highest potential)
* preventing body diode conduction to VDD or between nodes
.subckt cp_pump clk pump_node vdd vss
* D1: PMOS diode, bulk=cnode (drain). N-well floats with cnode.
XD1 cnode cnode vdd cnode sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* Flying cap between cnode and CLK (~10pF)
XCFLY cnode clk sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71 mult=1
* D2: PMOS diode, bulk=pump_node (drain). N-well floats with pump_node.
XD2 pump_node pump_node cnode pump_node sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cp_pump

* Error amplifier: 2-stage Miller, PMOS diff pair
.subckt cp_erramp fb vref ibias_p out vdd vss
* Tail current source (~8uA)
XMP_TAIL tail ibias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS diff pair
XMP1 d1 fb   tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 d2 vref tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* NMOS mirror load
XMN1 d1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 d2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* Second stage: PMOS CS with resistor load for high gain
XMP_S2 out d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XRLOAD out vss vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
* Miller compensation (~5pF MIM + small series resistor)
XRCOMP d2 ncomp vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2
XCCOMP ncomp out sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=1
.ends cp_erramp

* Top-level regulated charge pump
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* Bias circuit
XBIAS IBN1U bias_p vref EN AVDD AVSS cp_bias

* Clock generator
XCLK CLK EN clk_a clk_b AVDD AVSS cp_clkgen

* Dickson voltage doubler
XPUMP clk_a pump_node AVDD AVSS cp_pump

* Error amplifier
XAMP fb vref bias_p shunt_gate AVDD AVSS cp_erramp

* Shunt regulator
XSHUNT VOUT shunt_gate AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* VOUT feedback divider (VOUT -> fb -> AVSS)
XRFB1 VOUT fb   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=80
XRFB2 fb   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=50

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Inverter subcircuit
.subckt sky130_inv in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sky130_inv

* 2-input NAND subcircuit
.subckt sky130_nand2 a b out vdd vss
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN1 out a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sky130_nand2

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ── Enable-derived signals ──
XINV_EN_B EN EN_B AVDD AVSS sky130_inv

* ── Clock generation ──
XINV_CLK CLK CLK_N AVDD AVSS sky130_inv
* n_m3 = CLK AND PUMP_ENABLE → drives M1/M3 NMOS gates
XNAND1 CLK PUMP_ENABLE n_m1_raw AVDD AVSS sky130_nand2
XINV1 n_m1_raw n_m3 AVDD AVSS sky130_inv
* M4 gate: NAND(CLK_N, PUMP_ENABLE) buffered
XNAND2 CLK_N PUMP_ENABLE n_m4_raw AVDD AVSS sky130_nand2
XINV_M4_B1 n_m4_raw n_m4_b AVDD AVSS sky130_inv
XINV_M4_B2 n_m4_b M4_GATE AVDD AVSS sky130_inv

* ── Charge pump core (Dickson voltage doubler) ──
* Phase A (CLK=1): M1 ON → VFLY_T charges toward AVDD-Vtn; M3 ON → VFLY_B=0
* Phase B (CLK=0): M4 ON → VFLY_B=VDD; VFLY_T rises; M2 diode delivers to VOUT
* M1: NMOS switch, drain=AVDD, source=VFLY_T, gate=n_m3
XM1 AVDD n_m3 VFLY_T AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=2
* M3: NMOS switch, VFLY_B to AVSS
XM3 VFLY_B n_m3 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=2
* M4: PMOS switch, AVDD to VFLY_B
XM4 VFLY_B M4_GATE AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=2
* M2: PMOS diode, VFLY_T to VOUT (conducts when VFLY_T > VOUT+|Vtp|)
XM2 VOUT VOUT VFLY_T VFLY_T sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=2
* Flying capacitor (~9pF MIM)
XC_FLY VFLY_T VFLY_B sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=60 l=100 mult=1
* Tiny native NMOS clamp: prevents VOUT from going too negative during startup
* With very small W, conducts just enough to counteract 50uA load at VOUT<0
XM_CLAMP VOUT AVSS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=2 w=0.5 nf=1

* ── Bias circuit ──
XM5 VBIAS VBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XM6 VBIAS EN_B AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XM7 COMP_TAIL VBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ── Reference divider (VREF≈0.816V at 1.98V supply) ──
XM_R3_EN R3_TOP EN_B AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XR3 R3_TOP VREF_NODE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XR4 VREF_NODE AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=70

* ── Feedback divider (VOUT_target≈2.61V≈1.32×VDD) ──
XR1 VOUT VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=220
XR2 VFB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100

* ── Comparator ──
XM9 COMP_P VREF_NODE COMP_TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XM10 COMP_OUT VFB COMP_TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XM11 COMP_P COMP_P AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XM12 COMP_OUT COMP_P AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XR_PU COMP_OUT AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000
XR_PD COMP_P AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1000

* ── Enable logic ──
XNAND_EN COMP_OUT EN n_en AVDD AVSS sky130_nand2
XINV_PEN n_en PUMP_ENABLE AVDD AVSS sky130_inv

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump - Sky130 PDK
* VOUT regulated to ~1.3*VDD via comparator feedback
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* scale=1u (all dimensions in um)

* === BIAS ===
* NMOS diode-connected: IBN1U=n6, 1uA flows from IBN1U through M14 to AVSS
* n6 = Vgs ≈ 0.75V (for 1uA with W=1, L=4)
XM14  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=1 l=4
* Invert EN for enable/disable gating
XM_EN_BAR_P EN_BAR EN   AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=0.84 l=0.15
XM_EN_BAR_N EN_BAR EN   AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=0.42 l=0.15
* When disabled: pull IBN1U/n6 to AVSS (sinks 1uA, turns off tail)
XM_PULL_BIAS IBN1U EN_BAR AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15

* === REGULATION COMPARATOR ===
* NMOS tail current mirror - mirrors bias with ratio
* M14: W/L = 1/4 = 0.25. M_TAIL: W/L = 4/1 = 4. Ratio = 4/0.25 = 16.
* Tail current = 1uA * 16 = 16uA
XM_TAIL tail_node IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1
* NMOS differential pair
* VFB on M9, VREF on M10. When VFB < VREF: n7 LOW -> REG HIGH (pump ON)
XM9   n5   VFB  tail_node AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=1
XM10  n7   VREF tail_node AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=1
* PMOS current mirror load
XM13  n5   n5   AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=1
XM14b n7   n5   AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=1
* Self-biased inverter (second stage, provides digital REG output)
XM16  AVDD  REG REG   AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=6 l=1
XM17  REG  REG  AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=2 l=1
RFB   REG  n7   1MEG
* When disabled: pull REG LOW to ensure pump stays off
XM_PULL_REG REG EN_BAR AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15

* === VOLTAGE DIVIDERS ===
R5    AVDD  VREF 100k
R6    VREF  AVSS 330k
R3    VOUT  VFB  68k
R4    VFB   AVSS 100k

* === CLOCK GATING ===
* CLK_INT = CLK when (EN & REG=1), else VDD
* NAND(EN, REG) -> n20
XM20a n20  EN   AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=0.84 l=0.15
XM20b n20  REG  AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=0.84 l=0.15
XM20c n20  EN   n21   AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=0.42 l=0.15
XM20d n21  REG  AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=0.42 l=0.15
* INV -> EN_REG
XM21a EN_REG n20 AVDD  AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=0.84 l=0.15
XM21b EN_REG n20 AVSS  AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=0.42 l=0.15
* INV(CLK) -> CLK_BAR
XM22a CLK_BAR CLK AVDD AVDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=0.84 l=0.15
XM22b CLK_BAR CLK AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=0.42 l=0.15
* NAND(CLK_BAR, EN_REG) -> CLK_INT (direct, no extra inverter!)
* EN_REG=1: CLK_INT=CLK. EN_REG=0: CLK_INT=VDD (S1 OFF)
XM23a CLK_INT CLK_BAR AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.15
XM23b CLK_INT EN_REG  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=4 l=0.15
XM23c CLK_INT CLK_BAR n23   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=2 l=0.15
XM23d n23    EN_REG   AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=2 l=0.15

* === VOLTAGE DOUBLER PUMP ===
* PMOS switch S1: CLK_INT=0 -> ON (precharge), CLK_INT=VDD -> OFF (boost)
* g5v0d10v5 for 2*VDD on drain. Bulk=node_A.
XM1  node_A CLK_INT AVDD  node_A  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5  w=40 l=0.5
* Flying cap between node_A and CLK_INT
CFLY  node_A CLK_INT 40p
* Diode PMOS D2: node_A -> VOUT during boost. Bulk=node_A.
XM2  VOUT  VOUT  node_A  node_A  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5  w=40 l=0.5
* Output cap
COUT  VOUT  AVSS  10p

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Top: charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*
* Architecture
*   EN header  : 5 V PMOS header AVDD->VDDI, enabled by active-high EN.
*   Bias       : 1uA into IBN1U diode-connects a 1.8 V NMOS; mirrored to
*                the error-amp tail.  A 5 V PMOS current-source bias is
*                set by a poly resistor from a diode-connected 5 V PMOS.
*   Doubler    : two MIM flying caps.  Charge path is a 3.3 V native NMOS
*                diode (VDDI->VFLY, vth0~0.07 V, eta0=0 so it really
*                blocks reverse).  Transfer path is a cross-coupled 5 V
*                PMOS (VFLY->VPUMP, zero drop, gate = other flying node).
*                Large flying caps keep Rout droop small so VPUMP stays
*                above VOUT+dropout at the ss corner.
*   Regulator  : PMOS pass device VPUMP->VOUT.  Two-stage amp compares
*                VFB=VOUT*(5/13) with VREF=AVDD/2 so VOUT=1.3*AVDD.
*   Shutdown   : header opens; VREF divider bottom switch opens;
*                AVDD pin sees only PMOS subthreshold leak.

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable inverter (powered from AVDD so EN is always interpreted)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPE_EN ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMNE_EN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* AVDD header -> VDDI.  ENB=0 when EN=1.  Wide/long for low on-drop
* and low disabled leakage.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_HDR VDDI ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=400 nf=10

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: 1uA at IBN1U -> diode Vgs; mirrored tail for the error amp.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMB_D  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMB_T  AMPSS IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock buffers from VDDI.  SWA follows CLK, SWB follows CLKb.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINV1 CLK SWB VDDI AVSS inv_1v8
XINV2 SWB SWA VDDI AVSS inv_1v8

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Flying-cap voltage doubler
*   Charge  : 3.3 V native NMOS diode VDDI -> VFLYx (gate=drain=VDDI).
*             Bin l=0.8 w>=4 has vth0~0.07 and eta0=0, so the drop is
*             tiny and reverse is actually blocked (unlike nfet_05v0_nvt
*             whose eta0=9 shorts in reverse).
*   Transfer: 5 V PMOS VFLYx -> VPUMP, gate = the other flying node.
*             During transfer VFLYx=2*VDDI and VFLYy=VDDI so Vsg=VDDI
*             (fully on, no diode drop).  During charge Vsg=0 even in
*             reverse (VPUMP higher).  Bulk = VPUMP.
*   Caps    : 200um x 200um MIM (~80pF) each so Rout ~ 0.6k at 10MHz.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XCA   SWA  VFLYA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200
XCB   SWB  VFLYB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200

* charge diodes VDDI -> VFLYx
XMD1  VDDI VDDI VFLYA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.8 w=40 nf=2
XMD2  VDDI VDDI VFLYB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.8 w=40 nf=2

* transfer switches VFLYx -> VPUMP (cross-coupled PMOS)
XMP_T1 VPUMP VFLYB VFLYA VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=200 nf=10
XMP_T2 VPUMP VFLYA VFLYB VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=200 nf=10

* pump reservoir
XCVP  VPUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* LDO pass device VPUMP -> VOUT
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_PAS VOUT GPAS VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=200 nf=10

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Ratio-metric dividers
*   VREF = AVDD/2  (bottom switch opens when EN=0 so no AVDD current)
*   VFB  = VOUT*5/13 = VOUT/2.6
*   loop => VOUT = 1.3*AVDD
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRV1    AVDD VREF  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=50
XRV2    VREF VREFN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=50
XMN_GV  VREFN EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XRV3    VOUT VFB   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=400
XRV4    VFB  AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=250

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Error-amp stage 1: LVT NMOS pair + 1.8 V PMOS active load (VDDI)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP1    COLA COLA VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMP2    COL1 COLA VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMN1    COLA VREF AMPSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMN2    COL1 VFB  AMPSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage-2 bias: diode 5 V PMOS + poly resistor sets the current-source
* gate.  Stage 2 itself: 5 V PMOS source into 5 V NMOS common-source.
* Startup: BIASP is dead until VPUMP>|Vtp|, MN_CS is on, GPAS is low,
* so the pass device conducts and VOUT charges.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_B   VPUMP BIASP BIASP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XRB     BIASP AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=250
XMP_L   GPAS BIASP VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMN_CS  GPAS COL1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=20 nf=2

* Miller compensation
XCMIL   GPAS COL1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=32 l=32

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Internal output capacitance (supplements the bench 1 nF)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XCVOUT  VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Local inverter, 1.8 V devices.
.subckt inv_1v8 IN OUT VDD VSS
XMPI OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMNI OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv_1v8

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pin order: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*
* Single flying-cap doubler:
*   S1 PMOS (bulk=N1) charges Cfly from AVDD while CLKI is low.
*   Bottom plate is driven from CLKI through a small R (current from CLK pin).
*   N1 bootstraps to 2*AVDD when CLKI rises.
*   S3 PMOS + series NFET blocker dumps into VPUMP; the NFET (gate=N1,
*   bulk=AVSS) blocks the PMOS well diode when N1 is low.
* LDO: PMOS pass from VPUMP to VOUT, VFB=VOUT*10/13 compared to AVDD.
* Bang-bang pump enable from VPUMP/3 vs AVDD/2.
* IBN1U is a Vgs bias (TB 1uA into a diode-connected nfet).

* ============================================================
* local digital cells (vdd/vss domain)
* ============================================================
.subckt cpr_inv in out vdd vss
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends cpr_inv

.subckt cpr_inv2 in out vdd vss
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
.ends cpr_inv2

.subckt cpr_nand2 a b out vdd vss
XMNA na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMNB out b na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMPA out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMPB out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends cpr_nand2

.subckt cpr_nor2 a b out vdd vss
XMNA out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMNB out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMPA na a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMPB out b na vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends cpr_nor2

.subckt cpr_and2 a b out vdd vss
XNAB a b nab vdd vss cpr_nand2
XIB nab out vdd vss cpr_inv
.ends cpr_and2

.subckt cpr_or2 a b out vdd vss
XNOR a b nob vdd vss cpr_nor2
XIO nob out vdd vss cpr_inv
.ends cpr_or2

* ============================================================
* comparator: out high when vplus > vminus
* ibias is a gate-bias voltage (~0.6-0.7V), not a current
* ============================================================
.subckt cpr_cmp vplus vminus out ibias vdd vss
XMN1 n1 vplus tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN2 n2 vminus tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMP1 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMP2 out n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMTAIL tail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
.ends cpr_cmp

* ============================================================
* high-voltage comparator + inverters (powered from a high rail)
* ============================================================
.subckt cpr_cmp_hv vplus vminus out ibias vdd vss
XMN1 n1 vplus tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMN2 n2 vminus tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMP1 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMP2 out n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMTAIL tail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
.ends cpr_cmp_hv

.subckt cpr_inv_hv in out vdd vss
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
.ends cpr_inv_hv

.subckt cpr_inv2_hv in out vdd vss
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
.ends cpr_inv2_hv

* ============================================================
* top level
* ============================================================
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---- bias: IBN1U is Vgs of a 1uA diode (current from the TB) ----
XBIAS IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---- enable ----
XEN1 EN  ENN AVDD AVSS cpr_inv
XEN2 ENN ENC AVDD AVSS cpr_inv

* TAILG = IBN1U when enabled, AVSS when disabled
XSWT TAILG ENC IBN1U AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDT TAILG ENN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---- clock input gate: hold CLKI at 0 when disabled ----
XCGN CLKI ENC CLK AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XCGP CLKI ENN CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XCGH CLKI ENN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* CLKN only drives S3's gate (tiny load)
XC1 CLKI CLKN AVDD AVSS cpr_inv2

* ---- VPUMP regulation: VDM = VPUMP/3, VRA = AVDD/2 ----
XRV1 VPUMP VDM  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XRV2 VDM  VMID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XRV3 VMID AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XRA1 AVDD VRA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100
XRA2 VRA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=100

XCMPV VRA VDM CMPR TAILG AVDD AVSS cpr_cmp
XENR CMPR ENC ENR AVDD AVSS cpr_and2
XENRN ENR ENR_N AVDD AVSS cpr_inv

* S1G = CLKI & ENR   (PMOS S1 on when CLKI=0 and pump active)
* S3G = CLKN | ENR_N (PMOS S3 on when CLKN=0 and pump active)
XS1G CLKI ENR S1G AVDD AVSS cpr_and2
XS3G CLKN ENR_N S3G AVDD AVSS cpr_or2

* ---- doubler cell ----
* Bottom plate from CLKI through a small R so S1 opens before BOT rises.
* Charge current for Cfly comes from the CLK pin, not AVDD.
XRB CLKI BOT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2
XCFA N1 BOT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=75 l=75 mult=1

* S1: PMOS, bulk=N1 so the well follows the flying node (no clamp to AVDD)
XS1  N1  S1G AVDD N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* S3 transfer + NFET blocker (gate=N1) so VPUMP cannot leak back via well diode
XS3  N1  S3G NBLK N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
XBLK NBLK N1 VPUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

XCVP VPUMP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

* ---- LDO feedback divider: VFB = VOUT*10/13 ----
XRT1 VOUT VF1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRT2 VF1  VF2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRT3 VF2  VFB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB1 VFB  VB1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB2 VB1  VB2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB3 VB2  VB3 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB4 VB3  VB4 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB5 VB4  VB5 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB6 VB5  VB6 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB7 VB6  VB7 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB8 VB7  VB8 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB9 VB8  VB9 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20
XRB10 VB9 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=20

* ---- LDO error amp + pass (amp powered from VPUMP) ----
* VFB < AVDD (VOUT low) => VG high => VGI low => XPASS on
XERR AVDD VFB VG TAILG VPUMP AVSS cpr_cmp_hv
XERRI VG VGI VPUMP AVSS cpr_inv2_hv
XPASS VOUT VGI VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10

* disable pass when EN=0
XHVI ENN VGN VPUMP AVSS cpr_inv_hv
XPD1 VGI VGN VPUMP VPUMP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

XCOUT VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated 1.3x charge pump, Sky130 PDK devices only.
* Pin order: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Architecture: EN-gated 2-phase 3-stage Dickson pump (g5v0 switches) to HV,
* series PMOS pass LDO from HV to VOUT, OTA powered from HV, reference
* VREF = AVDD/2 gated off when disabled, feedback VOUT/2.6 so VOUT = 1.3*AVDD.
* IBN1U (1 uA) biases the OTA tail via a current mirror; the 1 uA bias current
* flows through the IBN1U pin and is outside the AVDD-pin current metric.
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable invert -> ENB (active low)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVENP ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINVENN ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Topology: switched flying-cap doubler -> VPP (~2*AVDD-Vth), PMOS LDO to VOUT=1.3*AVDD
* Phase 1 (PHI=1): S1 on (AVDD->N1), S3 on (N2->GND)  charge Cf
* Phase 2 (PII=1): S4 on (AVDD->N2), S2 on (N1->VPP)  pump Cf into VPP
* Non-overlapping PHI/PII prevent switch shoot-through and reverse dump.

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ===================== BIAS (IBN1U = 1 uA into pin) =====================
XBND  IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBNM  VBP   IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBPD  VBP   VBP   VPP  VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=4 nf=2

* ===================== CLOCK / ENABLE LOGIC =====================
XPI1  EN_B EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNI1  EN_B EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* CLK_G = EN & CLK   (0 when disabled -> pump parked, S1 off)
XPA   NANDO EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPB   NANDO CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNA   NANDO EN  NSER AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNB   NSER  CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPI2  CLK_G NANDO AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNI2  CLK_G NANDO AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* Non-overlap: DLY_C = delay(CLK_G); PHI = CLK_G & DLY_C; PII = ~(CLK_G | DLY_C)
XPI4  D1    CLK_G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNI4  D1    CLK_G AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPI5  DLY_C D1    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNI5  DLY_C D1    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

XPA1  NAND1 CLK_G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPB1  NAND1 DLY_C AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNA1  NAND1 CLK_G NS1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNB1  NS1   DLY_C AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPI8  PHI   NAND1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNI8  PHI   NAND1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

XPO1  NMID  CLK_G AVDD  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPO2  PII   DLY_C NMID  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNO1  PII   CLK_G AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNO2  PII   DLY_C AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

XPIA  NPII  PII   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNIA  NPII  PII   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ===================== CHARGE PUMP =====================
* S1: AVDD -> N1 during PHI. 5V PMOS, bulk=N1 (n-well follows N1 high).
XS1   N1 G1 AVDD N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=300 nf=30

* Floating inverter powered from N1: input PHI, output G1.
* XPU bleeds G1 to AVDD when the floating inverter is undriven (keeps S1 off).
XFP   G1 PHI N1   N1   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XFN   G1 PHI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5  nf=1
XPU   G1 AVSS AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=1 nf=1

* S3: N2 -> AVSS during PHI
XS3   N2 PHI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=300 nf=30

XS4   N2 CLK_G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=400 nf=40

* S2: N1 -> VPP during pump. PMOS passes the high side without a diode drop.
* Gate from floating inverter off N1, input PII: G2=N1 during charge (S2 off,
* Vsg=0 even while N1 is still high), G2=0 during pump (S2 hard on).
XS2   VPP G2 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=400 nf=40
XGP   G2 PII N1   N1   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XGN   G2 PII AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5  nf=1
XPD   G2 AVDD AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=1 nf=1

* Weak DC bleed on flying-cap nodes (enabled only) so dead-time does not float them
XBN1  N1 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=0.42 nf=1
XBN2  N2 EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=0.42 nf=1

* Flying cap and VPP reservoir (Cpp large so 10 MHz charge packets barely move VPP)
XCF   N1  N2   sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=250 l=250
XCPP  VPP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1000

* ===================== LDO =====================
* Pass device (5V PMOS). VG low = pass on.
XPASS VOUT VG VPP VPP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=160 nf=16

* Error amp in the AVDD domain: LVT PMOS diff pair, sources switched in by EN.
* VFB on MN1, VREF on MN2. Balanced when VFB=VREF => VOUT=1.3*AVDD.
XSRC  AVDD EN_B ESAV AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMN1  NOTA VFB  ESAV AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=2
XMN2  CMP  VREF ESAV AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=2
XMP1  NOTA NOTA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMP2  CMP  NOTA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

XCI2  CMPI CMP AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* Keep CMP defined when disabled (pull to AVDD => CMPI=0 => pass off path idle)
XPCMP CMP EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2

XVGS  VG   VBP  VPP  VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10 nf=2

* Feedback dividers: VFB = 0.5*VOUT, VREF = 0.65*AVDD when enabled
XR1   VOUT VFB     AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=250
XR2   VFB  AVSS    AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=250
XSWD  VDD_SW EN_B  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XR3   VDD_SW VREF  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=175
XR4   VREF   AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=325
XMNV  VREF   EN_B  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* Force pass OFF when EN=0 (VPP-domain inverter on EN_B)
XVPI  EN_VB EN_B VPP  VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XVNI  EN_VB EN_B AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
XPOFF VG    EN_VB VPP VPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* Startup clamp: PMOS with bulk=VOUT so no body diode conducts at high VOUT.
* Gate=source=VOUT => Vsg=0 when VOUT is up (off); Vsg=AVDD-VOUT when VOUT is
* negative (on) and pulls VOUT up against the load current source.
XCLP  AVDD VOUT VOUT VOUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=10 nf=2

* Output capacitor (bench adds 1 nF)
XCOUT VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=800 l=800

.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Regulation: bang-bang clock gating. Reference and sense are ratiometric
* dividers so the target tracks 1.3*VDD across corners and supply.
* The regulator rail is not header-isolated: divider/comparator footers are
* switched with EN so the disabled state draws only leakage from AVDD.

* Small inverter
.subckt cp_inv a vdd vss y
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends cp_inv

* Stronger inverter (clock path)
.subckt cp_invi a vdd vss y
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=1
.ends cp_invi

* Transmission gate
.subckt cp_tg io1 io2 en enb vdd vss
X1 io1 io2 en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.0 nf=1
X2 io1 io2 enb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40.0 nf=1
.ends cp_tg

* Big transmission gate for the gated clock
.subckt cp_tgbig io1 io2 en enb vdd vss
X1 io1 io2 en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100.0 nf=1
X2 io1 io2 enb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200.0 nf=1
.ends cp_tgbig

* Comparator: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load, switched tail, output inverter.
* Trips when VSENSE (= VOUT/2.6) crosses VREF (= VDD/2), i.e. at 1.3*VDD.
.subckt cp_cmp vinp vinn vdd vss en out
X1 n1 vinp ss1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1
X2 n2 vinn ss1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1
X3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1
X4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1
X5 out n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
X6 out n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
X7 ss1 en vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.0 nf=1
.ends cp_cmp

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Bias-current sink: IBN1U returns the 1 uA bias to AVSS.
XRB IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=333

* Enable buffer (static when EN is static -> no dynamic AVDD current).
XINV1 EN AVDD AVSS ENB cp_inv
XINV2 ENB AVDD AVSS ENINT cp_inv

XTGCLPD CLKP AVSS PUMPENB PUMPEN AVDD AVSS cp_tg
XINVCLKB CLKP AVDD AVSS CLKPB cp_invi

* Switched ground for the dividers (off when EN=0).
XFOOT AVSSG ENINT AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.0 nf=1

* Ratiometric references (bottom-referred to switched ground).
* Comparator hysteresis: resistor from output back to the sense node.
XRH VSENSE CMPOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=3333333
XRV1 AVDD VREF AVSSG sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=333
XRV2 VREF AVSSG AVSSG sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=333
XRV3 VOUT VSENSE AVSSG sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=533
XRV4 VSENSE AVSSG AVSSG sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=333

* Flying capacitors (2 fF/um^2 MIM): 4 pF each.
XC1 X1 CLKP sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=40
XC2 X2 CLKPB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=40

* Diode rectifiers (LVT for low drop), bulk tied to source.
XD1 AVDD AVDD X1 X1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5.0 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2 AVDD AVDD X2 X2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5.0 l=0.15 nf=1
XD3 X1 X1 VOUT VOUT sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5.0 l=0.15 nf=1
XD4 X2 X2 VOUT VOUT sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5.0 l=0.15 nf=1

* Output buffer capacitance (3 nF MIM) in parallel with the bench 1 nF.
XCB VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1500
.ends charge_pump_regulated

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump (Sky130 PDK devices only)
* Interface: charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* Regulation: clocked latch comparator, VSENSE = VOUT*3/4 vs AVDD => VOUT ~ 4/3 AVDD (~1.3*VDD)
* Bias 1 uA is sunk from IBN1U (excluded from the AVDD-pin current metric).
* MOSFET wrapper terminal order is drain, gate, source, bulk.
* When EN=0 the clock is gated and the comparator tail is off => no DC AVDD draw.

* ---------- local helpers: inverter, nand2, transmission gate ----------
.subckt inv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XN1 y a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt tg a b ctl ctlb vdd vss
XN a ctl b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XP a ctlb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
.ends tg

* ---------- regulated charge pump ----------
.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT
* gate the incoming clock with EN so no dynamic draw when disabled
XGCNAND CLK EN GCLKN AVDD AVSS nand2
XGCINV GCLKN GCLK AVDD AVSS inv
XCLKINV GCLK CLKB AVDD AVSS inv

* bias from IBN1U (1 uA): diode-connected NMOS reference -> IBN1U node
XMREF IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
* mirrored tail current for the clocked comparator
XMTAIL TAIL IBN1U SN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
* tail switch: comparator evaluates only while GCLK is high (off when disabled)
XMCLK SN GCLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1

* latched comparator: cross-coupled PMOS latch + NMOS diff pair
* XM1 gate=TAP, XM2 gate=AVDD  =>  N low when VOUT below target => pump on
XP3 P N AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP4 N P AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM1 P TAP TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XM2 N AVDD TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* PN high (rail) while evaluating and VOUT below target => pump on
XPNINV N PN AVDD AVSS inv

* pump request = comparator decision AND EN (steady level across the cycle)
XPRND PN EN PRQN AVDD AVSS nand2
XPRINV PRQN PUMPREQ AVDD AVSS inv

* pump clocks, gated by PUMPREQ
XPCNAND GCLK PUMPREQ PCLKN AVDD AVSS nand2

* divider on VOUT (270k/231k) is compared against a divider on AVDD (200k/300k)
* by a two-stage Miller OTA; the OTA drives the header gate so that
* VOUT = 0.6*(270+231)/231 * VDD = 1.3*VDD.  Non-overlap clocks S/T are
* generated from CLK by VINT-powered logic (OR of buffered clock with a delayed
* replica so both bottom plates are never low at once).

* to VINT while S is low; when S rises, CFLYB bottom plate bootstraps TOPA to

* Regulated voltage-doubling charge pump, sky130 PDK devices only.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Two-phase doubler pump: phase A (CLK high) charges flying cap XCFLY
*    from AVDD via S1 while S2 holds N2 at AVSS; phase B (CLK low) lifts
*    N2 to AVDD via S3 (bootstrapping N1 toward 2*VDD) and delivers charge
*    to storage node VP via S4.  VP therefore charges toward 2*VDD.
*  - S4's source sits at VP (up to ~2*VDD), so its gate is driven by a
*    cross-coupled Dickson level shifter (cpr_ls2) powered between VP and
*    AVSS: GS4 swings 0/VP with no static current path.
*  - PMOS pass element XPASS forms an LDO from VP to VOUT.  The error
*    amplifier (supplied from VP) compares FB = VOUT*2/3 against
*    REF = VDD*13/15, giving VOUT = 1.3*VDD.  The pass gate PG is the
*    amplifier output; Miller cap XCC compensates the loop.  XCFB keeps
*    the feedback divider ratio flat in frequency.  The amplifier tail is
*    a resistor so it needs no headroom from the 1 uA bias input.
*  - EN gates both clock phases with delayed turn-on / fast turn-off
*    (break-before-make).  With EN = 0: all switch gates sit at their
*    off levels, both dividers are disconnected (reference at the top by
*    XSWT, feedback at the bottom by XSWO), and XTAIL opens the amplifier
*    tail so neither input pair device can conduct.  Every pump node then
*    floats to a zero-bias diode equilibrium and the disabled state draws
*    only HV leakage.
*  - All logic uses 5 V devices: 1.8 V core devices leak heavily when
*    operated from a 1.98 V rail (off p-devices see |Vds| above rating).
*  - The 1 uA IBN1U input is sunk by diode XB.
*
* Local logic cells (HV devices; supplies passed as pins).
.subckt cpr_inv1 vd vs i o
XMP o i vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN o i vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends cpr_inv1

XMP o i vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

XMP1 o a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 o b vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN1 o a m1 vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 m1 b vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cpr_nand1

.subckt cpr_nand2 vd vs a b o
XMP1 o a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMP2 o b vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN1 o a m1 vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN2 m1 b vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
.ends cpr_nand2

* Cross-coupled (Dickson) level shifter: output swings between vs and vd
* (vd may be the pumped rail VP).  Inputs are complementary AVDD-level
* signals.  Once latched there is no static supply-to-ground path, unlike
* a single-inverter level shifter which fights itself when the input high
* level (AVDD) is below vd.
.subckt cpr_ls2 vd vs i ib o
XNL ls1 i vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XNR o ib vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XPL ls1 o vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XPR o ls1 vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends cpr_ls2

.subckt charge_pump_regulated AVDD AVSS CLK EN IBN1U VOUT

* ---- Clock conditioning and non-overlap gate drive ----
* PA = CLK&EN (phase A request), PB = ~CLK&EN (phase B request).
* S1/S2 gates: AND(PA, delayed PA) -> delayed turn-on, fast turn-off.
* NBG (active low phase B): NAND(PB, delayed PB) -> 0 in phase B only,
* with delayed turn-on (falling edge) and fast turn-off (rising edge).
XENV AVDD AVSS EN ENB cpr_inv1
XICLK AVDD AVSS CLK CLKB cpr_inv1
XNA AVDD AVSS CLK EN NA cpr_nand1
XPA AVDD AVSS NA PA cpr_inv1
XDA1 AVDD AVSS PA DA1 cpr_inv2
XDA2 AVDD AVSS DA1 DA2 cpr_inv2
XDA3 AVDD AVSS DA2 DA3 cpr_inv2
XDA4 AVDD AVSS DA3 DA4 cpr_inv2
XDA5 AVDD AVSS DA4 DA5 cpr_inv2
XDA6 AVDD AVSS DA5 DA6 cpr_inv2
XNAG AVDD AVSS PA DA6 NAG cpr_nand2
XGS2 AVDD AVSS NAG GS2 cpr_inv3
XGS1 AVDD AVSS GS2 GS1 cpr_inv3
XNB AVDD AVSS CLKB EN NB cpr_nand1
XPB AVDD AVSS NB PB cpr_inv1
XDB1 AVDD AVSS PB DB1 cpr_inv2
XDB2 AVDD AVSS DB1 DB2 cpr_inv2
XDB3 AVDD AVSS DB2 DB3 cpr_inv2
XDB4 AVDD AVSS DB3 DB4 cpr_inv2
XDB5 AVDD AVSS DB4 DB5 cpr_inv2
XDB6 AVDD AVSS DB5 DB6 cpr_inv2
XNBG AVDD AVSS PB DB6 NBG cpr_nand2

* ---- Gate power buffers ----
* Even inversion counts keep polarities; final stages drive the big
* switch gates (~100 fF each).
XG1A AVDD AVSS GS1 G1A cpr_inv3
XG1B AVDD AVSS G1A GS1B cpr_inv4
XG2A AVDD AVSS GS2 G2A cpr_inv3
XG2B AVDD AVSS G2A GS2B cpr_inv4
XINT AVDD AVSS NBG INT cpr_inv3
XNBGI AVDD AVSS INT NBGI cpr_inv4
* GS4 is NBG level-shifted to a 0/VP swing for S4 (INT and NBGI are the
* complementary inputs).
XGS4 VP AVSS INT NBGI GS4 cpr_ls2

* ---- Power pump (HV devices; internal nodes reach ~2*VDD) ----
* S1 bulk follows N1 and S4 bulk follows VP so no drain-well diode is
* forward biased while N1 swings above AVDD.
XS1 N1 GS1B AVDD N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=98 nf=14
XS2 N2 GS2B AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=49 nf=7
XS3 N2 NBGI AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=98 nf=14
XS4 VP GS4 N1 VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=98 nf=14
XCFLY N1 N2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=165 l=100
XCST VP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1000

* ---- LDO pass element ----
* XPASS passes VP to VOUT.  VOUT can dip a few tens of mV below ground
* at startup while ILOAD discharges the load cap; the pass drain-well
* diode clamps any large negative excursion.
XPASS VOUT PG VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=160 nf=20

* ---- Bias sink for the 1 uA IBN1U input ----
XB IBN1U IBN1U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Error amplifier (supplied from VP), pass gate is the output ----
* FB up -> M1 sinks more than the P1L mirror sources -> PG up -> XPASS
* throttles -> VOUT down (negative feedback).  At startup FB < REF, so
* M2 pulls PG low and the pass element stays on until VOUT approaches
* the target.  Resistor XRTAIL sets the tail current (~7 uA) without
* needing gate-overdrive headroom from the bias input.  XTAIL opens the
* tail when EN = 0 so the pair cannot conduct in the disabled state.
XM1 NDM FB TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM2 PG REF TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XP2L NDM NDM VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XP1L PG NDM VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XCC PG VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=500
XRTAIL TAIL TAILX AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=61
XTAIL TAILX EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---- Minimum load for light-load regulation (off if disabled) ----
XBL VOUT EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1.5 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---- Feedback divider: FB = VOUT * 2/3 (switched by EN) ----
* XCFB compensates the divider pole from the resistor parasitic caps.
* When disabled, XSWO opens and XRT1 holds FB at VOUT.
XRT1 VOUT FB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=736
XRB1 FB RSWO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1473
XSWO RSWO EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XCFB VOUT FB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=7

* ---- Reference divider: REF = VDD * 13/15 ----
* XSWT (pfet, gate ENB) disconnects the divider from AVDD when EN = 0.
XSWT R2T ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XRT2 R2T REF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=226
XRB2 REF AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1473

.ends charge_pump_regulated
